sth_start.77.desc:
Start a playthrough with a number or all of the minor and primitive races set to use static population growth. These countries will not add to the late game population density of the galaxy unless they progress to a full power or are absorbed into another larger empire, such as the UFP or Dominion. It is theorised that pop size contributes to late game lag.

Dev Note: Use at own risk and does not guarentee improved performance whilst in trial mode.
sth_start.77.f.tooltip: This experience is recommended for the full experience, with no empires downgraded to static. Run at own risk.
sth_start.77.name: Start Conditions
sth_start.999.desc:
Welcome to the Autumn content update for STNH! We have made a number of changes to New Horizons based on player feedback and experience that we would like to share with you all. We hope you enjoy! 

The Flagship system has been overhauled, you can now build either the military flagship or the science flagship, each have unique bonuses, but you are limited to one per class of ship. 

The Federation and Terran empires now have access to new fleetyard facility that is available as a megastructure which allows you to build Flagships and certain legendary ships. 

Flagships are now only buildable via the Fleetyard. 

The early game Demon's mission has been re-written to pose a whole new challenge and play style for Terra Prime. 

Many changes made to the Dominion in line with player feedback, including the desire to increase the number of Dominion Members. 

The new Challenge Mode is now available on Grand Admiral difficulty and provides an artificially challenging experience for those who want a tough game! 

New event expansions - experience our recreation of Star Trek Picard, Nemesis, First Contact and a few more! 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's mod, brought to you by PDG.
sth_start.999.desc_01:
Welcome to the Scorpio Expansion STNH! We have been hard at work producing our largest patch yet. We hope you enjoy! 

The mysterious and dangerous Species 8472, the Undine, are now a playable species with a unique play style. Pick the Undine and conquer the galaxy. 

A new crisis is available involving the Undine and the mysteries of Fluidic Space. 

Support Craft are available to build to help defend starbases. 

Leaders now have the option to retire and pick a new career as a legend, teacher or continue serving you! 

More quality of life improvements made to the Dominion based on feedback from the community. 

The new Challenge Mode is now available on Grand Admiral difficulty and provides an artificially challenging experience for those who want a tough game! 

The Borg Adaptation Mechanic has been updated to version 3.0, fear the Borg! 

We have integrated the Espionage system into the Mod, there are 3 empire tiers meaning that not all empires have access to the features, but those that do should be feared. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's mod, brought to you by PDG.
sth_start.999.desc_02:
Welcome to the late Summer Scorpio Expansion update for STNH! We have been looking at a number of the issues that you have raised and implemented a number of fixes and improvements. We hope you enjoy! 

We recognise much of the feedback on Species 8472 and have worked hard to fix many of the common issues and continue to expand on their play style. 

The mysterious Barzan Wormhole is available to purchase, if you own the Barzan sector and speak with them whilst they are still warm primitives. 

We've made a number of quality of life changes to the Klingon Houses, including making it easier to tell how they view you. Their opinion level of the Empire now reflects their loyalty 

You can now artifically hold back technology research to keep things in time with the in game date! 

More refit vessels have been added for those who prefer the classic look 

The new Challenge Mode is now available for the Mirror Universe 

We've continued our efforts to optimise the code to provide a better performance late game 

Plus much more detailed in our Patch Notes. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's mod, brought to you by PDG.
sth_start.999.desc_03:
Welcome to the 3.1.2 Scorpio Expansion compat update for STNH! We hope you enjoy! 

Our existing traditions have now been made compatible with the new system introduced in 3.1. We will continue to adapt them to to take full advantage of the new mechanic in future patches. 

New tier 2 traditions have been introduced which unlock as you progress through the original ones. We will be adding more traditions in future patches 

One of the most asked for new mechanics is the troop deployment during combat. Now ships with marine components will try and board vessels 

Troop Carriers now have unique bombardment settings! 

New ship classes for the Klingons, Romulans and Federation 

Some love for Lower Decks Season 2 added 

We've continued our efforts to optimise the code to provide a better performance late game 

Plus much more detailed in our Patch Notes. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's mod, brought to you by PDG.
sth_start.999.desc_04:
Welcome to our Traditions 2.0.1 update for the Scorpio Expansion of STNH! In this update we have overhauled the Traditions to fix a number of issues and make them more fun to work through. We hope you enjoy! 

We have separated out our existing traditions to make them their own unique branches. 

New tier 2 traditions have been introduced which unlock as you progress through the original ones. We will be adding more traditions in future patches 

Unlock unique mechanics, ships and stations as you complete the various race specific traditions trees! 

Feedback from the boarding mechanic has been taken onboard and implemented, thanks to all who fed back 

The geniuses are in the house, a new rare trait creates some real clever clogs! 

We've continued our efforts to optimise the code to provide a better performance late game 

Plus much more detailed in our Patch Notes. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's mod, brought to you by PDG.
sth_start.999.desc_05:
Welcome to our 3.2 Compat Patch for the Scorpio Expansion of STNH! This update contains a number of fixes and changes to support the 3.2 Herbert Release from PDX. We hope you enjoy! 

We have heard how seriously you guys take canon/non canon ships, our latest tradition named after the series of the same name lets you decide whether you want to include a number of bonus non-canon ships. 

Community content! We have kicked off our very own community contribution scheme... the collective and this patch includes content written by fine folk! 

Minor empire ship sets, we're continuing our quest to flesh out the minor races ship sets to expand the Trek experience. 

Aquatics Pack - for those of you who have this species pack you can play as the 'turtly awesome' Chelarians and adds the warp capable Selkies 

Further performance increases by optimising old events 

Plus much more detailed in our Patch Notes. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's mod, brought to you by PDG.
sth_start.999.desc_06:
Seasons greetings and welcome to our final patch of the year! The dev team have been hard at work preparing one final update for 2021 and a number of fixes and changes that have been requested. We hope you enjoy! 

We've been hard at work withour community team "the Collective" to rework and improve all of the maps we offer. 

We have given some of the minor races some STNH love with some new portraits and added everyone fave pacifists the Mizarians to the map! 

A lot of work has gone into balancing the starting conditions across the majority of races, and this will continue into 2022. 

The Undine special weapons previously locked behind DLC now has a workaround so that everyone can enjoy. 

As we move towards 3.3 our focus will be on the AI and how it balances its economy, and we look forward to teasing more 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's mod and have a fantastic New Year. 

 All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_07:
Greetings and Happy New Year from us all at PDG! A new year and a new patch including number of fixes and changes that align with Libra 3.3! 

A huge amount of work has gone into the AI and how it builds, with buildings and districts overhauled and where we can brought inline with the Vanilla AI changes. 

Maps have been further updated and we're working with a group of lore experts to make some exciting changes! 

A new major endgame crisis has been introduced, no spoilers... you will just have to discover it. 

Optional canon war scenarios have been introduced for those who love to role play certain events. 

Experience the Wrath of Khan in one of two unique ways. 

We are continuing to introduce as many of the exciting Vanilla changes in a controlled manner as possible, the future is interesting. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's.

 All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_08:
Greetings from us all at PDG! Thank you for your patience whilst we have been hard at work on our 3.4 release! The teams have been hard at work on a number of behind-the-scenes changes securing the future of STNH and improving performance! 

With the help of PDX we have been working on the triggers we use to bring more optimised performance across the mod. 

For fans of a more violent play style we have added the Confederacy of Earth set within the prime universe map. 

The Borg Adaption mechanism has been upgraded and improved based on feedback from players. 

The list of leaders for the Mirror Universe has been refreshed and updated. 

Lots of love has been given to ST:SNW with a few new additions from the show added to the game. 

The Klingon Great Houses have been re-worked behind the scenes to take maximum effect of the new mechanics. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's.

 All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_09:
Greetings from us all at PDG! A wave of excitement rushes through the Q Continuum, it's patch time once again. Our 3.5 base compatibility release contains a number of fixes carried over from 3.4 as well as some exciting performance improvements. 

Using the new script profiler we have anaylsed and improved a number of scripts and triggers to speed up gameplay, this will be part of a continued effort on our part. 

Game balance has been a heavy focus this time as pretty much all empires have been reviewed and updated. 

We have reviewed and made some much needed improvements to how wars are conducted to avoid some of those endless wars that no one wants to see. 

The new lore map has had yet more planets added and many of the random made up systems replaced with real life stars. 

The UFP now has a separate contact for the Federation Council and many of the mechanics that sat in the yearly event have been split between this council & the science stations. 

A great number of fixes and feedback have been included. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's.

 All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_10:
Greetings from us all at PDG! As we reach the conclusion of a long run of exciting new Trek on our TVs, what better to do than play some STNH and our 3.5.3 Patch... 

We have continued to review the new performance profiling tools and have further optimized and replaced older inefficient code to improve performance. 

More empires have undergone balance review and improvements. 

We have added the Tomed Incident as a pivotal moment in Federation/Romulan history. 

The new lore map now has a Mirror Universe version, something that you have been calling out for. 

A great number of fixes and feedback have been included. 

 Our focus has already started looking at our next major patch and looking at more exciting changes for 3.6 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's.

 All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_11:
Hello from us all at PDG! This month we bring you a patch that has us very excited due to some of the very cool new features in 3.7 and the FC DLC... 

This DLC comes with cloaking! We have worked hard to adapt the new cloaking mechanics for all those who decide to buy the new DLC. 

For players without the DLC we have made some improvements to the original cloaking set up to make it feel more unique. 

You said, we did! We have looked at balancing Starbase battles, with scaling bonuses and a reduction in weapon range, with the aim to create powerful Starbases, that allow you to engage them fairly. 

Buzz Buzz Crackle Crackle... we now have Breen Voice Overs. 

The new Q-pedia has been added, just talk to Q for lots of hints and tips for playing STNH. 

As always we have included new events, ships and fixes along with everything you need to enjoy 3.7. We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

 All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_12:
Hello from us all at PDG! We'd like to introduce you to our 3.8 patch and the Paragons DLC... 

One of the biggest changes in this patch is the introduction of the new star option, you can now customize how many minor empires are part of your playthrough. 

We have revamped the hero system and leader mechanics into a 3 tiered system in line with the changes from Paragons. 

To honor the return of the Enterprise-D in Picard, we have a new major story mission, play along with our take on Generations. 

Our team have been working behind the scenes to make a number of performance improvements. 

The new Q-pedia has been expanded with more questions answered, just talk to Q for lots of hints and tips for playing STNH. 

As always we have included new events, ships and fixes along with everything you need to enjoy 3.8. We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

 All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_13:
Hello from us all at PDG! Hope you all enjoyed the summer, to kick off Autumn (here at least) we have our 3.9 patch... 

We have been working with the MP community to make a number of important changes that should improve the multiplayer experience. 

We have made a number of changes and fixes to the random maps, making them more random and mappy than ever before. 

The Borg have received some love to their councilors, with new ones added and improvements to their traits. 

Our team have been working behind the scenes to make a number of performance improvements. 

As always we have included a few new events, ships, and fixes along with everything you need to enjoy 3.9. We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_14:
Seasons Greetings from us all at PDG! We are really excited to bring you our Next Generation and 3.10 patch... 

Welcome to the Next Generation, play STNH starting from 2300. 

New Maps and events that propel you into the Lost Era of Trek. 

Leader portraits have been massively overhauled to look absolutely brilliant. 

Our team has been working behind the scenes to make a number of performance improvements. 

We have exciting new story arcs re-written to make use of the new situation arcs. 

We've reviewed our hero leaders to make them compatible with the changes made to enjoy 3.10. We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_15:
Hello from us all at PDG! We are excited to bring you the 3.11 patch... 

We have included our 3.11.1 base compat changes, with further updates reviewing the new features. 

We've listened to feedback and included the starting options to remove crisis and story events. 

Leader age reviews have taken place, hopefully catching any leaders spawning too young!. 

New events to play out the Bajoran occupation. 

Late game performance improvements. 

We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_16:
Hello from us all at PDG! We are excited to bring you our latest expansion... A Mirror Shattered 

We have included our 3.11.3 base compat changes, with further updates reviewing the new features. 

This patch contains a brand new set of maps for the Mirror Universe starting from the 2300s. 

Experience a new story set in the MU 

Now play as the Terran Resistance, Coalition of Hope and The Alliance. 

All new ships and leader portraits added to expand the experience. 

Combat science ships have been expanded for each empire!. 

We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_17:
Hello from us all at PDG! Thank you for bearing with us as we work on our update for 3.14. 

We have included our 3.14.15 base compat changes, with further updates reviewing the new features. 

We've added in a number of new relics and specimens for the Trek museums. 

Our expeditions are slowly being updated to use the new situation mechanism. 

Taking advantage of the capture mechanics to use by Borg and Boarding Parties. 

Many fixes and other changes listed in the patch notes. 

We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_18:
Hello from us all at PDG! It has finally arrived, our 4.0.* release has made it out of the hangar bay! This update has changed so many elements behind the scenes & we wanted to make sure we were happy and stable before releasing, but a big thank you to all the Devs & Beta testers who have made this possible. 

We have included our 4.0 base compat changes, with further updates reviewing the new features. 

The pop system has been re-written to take advance of the vanilla improvements. 

Planet starts and balances have been re-worked. 

Coming soon, Undine Ships using the new DLC and the Citadel mechanic. 

Many fixes and other changes listed in the patch notes. 

As always we will need your help to report balance and bugs as we work through this major change to STNH, We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_19:
Hello from us all at PDG! The 1st major patch of our 10th Anniversary year, ready to support the 4.3 release. 

We have included our 4.3 base compat changes, including significant changes to ship and fleet sizes. 

The economy changes from the base game have been worked into the mod 

Significant performance improvements have been included to give our best performance yet. 

Long running events and mechanics have been re-written and tightened up to reduce errors and improve performance. 

Many fixes and other changes listed in the patch notes. 

As always we will need your help to report balance and bugs as we work through this major change to STNH, We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.name: What's new in ST Horizons

sthera.1.a.tooltip: Captain Carter-Lin transfers from the Starfleet Design Bureau and awaits assignment.
sthera.1.desc:
Buried deep in the bowels of Earth Spacedock a quiet revolution in Starship design has taken place. For nearly five years Captain Carter-Lin of the Starship Design Bureau has led a team of experts in the fields of warp theory and metallurgy, all striving to provide Starfleet with a new generation of vessels fit to take Starfleet's message of peaceful exploration across the quadrant. 

Smooth white duranium alloys, bright gold picofibre deflector dishes and spiral vortex bussard collector domes offer substantial advantages over preceding technology.
sthera.1.desc_evil:
Buried deep in the bowels of [Root.Capital.GetName] Spacedock a quiet revolution in starship design has taken place. For nearly five years Captain Carter-Lin of the Starship Design Bureau has led a team of experts in the fields of warp theory and metallurgy, all striving to provide Starfleet with a new generation of vessels fit to demonstrate Starfleet's strength across the quadrant. 

Smooth white duranium alloys, bright gold picofibre deflector dishes and spiral vortex bussard collector domes offer substantial advantages over preceding technology.
sthera.1.name: A Bold New Era
sthera.10.desc:
Kutaya and Valda's raptors had performed admirably for many years, however untold stories of guile, conquest and battle from thousands of deep space raid reports and border skirmishes have found their way back to the restructured Ministry of War. 

These reports - coupled with improvements from the latest offensive technology - have resulted in a wave of new raptor designs fit to face the galaxy, for the glory of Romulus.
sthera.10.name: The Raptor's Wings, Made Anew
sthera.11.a: Captain Taldor takes command of the PWB Koderex.
sthera.11.desc:
The galaxy remains a dangerous place, and while Romulan captains continue to outguile their enemies the Empire must not become complacent. 

A new wave of warbird design has emerged from the Ministry of War, to account for the new challenges that have emerged and new weapons wielded by the other great powers. 

The experimental warbird Koderex, captained under Taldor, exemplifies the qualities of this new era - overwhelming power and force of presence.
sthera.11.name: The Raptor's Wings, Made Anew
sthera.12.desc: A new era of technological superiority awaits for our people, who proudly fight for the glory of the empire.
sthera.12.name: The Raptor's Wings, Made Anew
sthera.13.desc: Working tirelessly on [Root.Capital.GetName]'s orbital spacedock, a quiet revolution in warship design has taken place. For nearly five years the scientist [newOfficer.GetName] of the Naval Design Academy has led a team of experts in the fields of warp theory and metallurgy, all striving to provide [Root.Capital.GetName] with a new generation of vessels fit to defend the [Root.GetName]'s interests across the quadrant.
sthera.13.name: A New Era
sthera.14.desc:
Teraquads of data from millions of cubic lightyears of deep space exploration reports and border skirmishes have been poured over by experts at the Naval Design Academy on [Root.Capital.GetName]. 

This data - coupled with optimisations from the latest propulsion and defensive technology - has resulted in a wave of new designs fit to face the galaxy and promote the [Root.GetName]'s interests. 

The unarmed test platform for these new designs - the warship [newShip.GetName] - is now released for refit, alongside her commanding officer Captain [newOfficer.GetName].
sthera.14.name: A New Era
sthera.15.desc:
Advances in material sciences coupled with the maturation of the [Root.GetName]'s defensive technologies has resulted in a new generation of warship designs. 

The unarmed test platform for these new designs - the cruiser [newShip.GetName] - is now released for refit, alongside her commanding officer Captain [newOfficer.GetName].
sthera.15.name: A New Era
sthera.16.name: A New Era
sthera.17.desc:
Perfection is elusive, but it is our purpose. Through the assimilation of new species and the acquisition of more and more data, we are able to reshape both ourself and our vessels. 

Geometry will always be at the heart of our... aesthetic, but the techniques we employ to fulfil it continue to evolve.
sthera.17.name: The Geometry of Change

sthera.2.a: Captain Esteban takes command of the USS Grissom.
sthera.2.desc:
Captain Carter-Lin's starships performed admirably for many years, however teraquads of data from millions of cubic lightyears of deep space exploration reports and border skirmishes have since flowed through to the analysts at the Starship Design Bureau. 

This data - coupled with optimisations from the latest propulsion and defensive technology - has resulted in a wave of new Starship designs fit to face the galaxy and promote Starfleet's message of peace. 

The test platform for these new designs - the science vessel USS Grissom - is now released for standard duties, alongside her commanding officer Captain Jonathan Esteban.
sthera.2.desc_evil:
Captain Carter-Lin's starships performed admirably for many years, however teraquads of data from millions of cubic lightyears of deep space exploitation reports and border skirmishes have since flowed through to the analysts at the Starship Design Bureau. 

This data - coupled with optimisations from the latest propulsion and defensive technology - has resulted in a wave of new Starship designs fit to face the galaxy and promote Starfleet's interests. 

The test platform for these new designs - the science vessel USS Grissom - is now released for standard duties, alongside her commanding officer Captain Jonathan Esteban.

Perfection is elusive, but it is our purpose. Through the assimilation of new species and the acquisition of more and more data, we are able to reshape both ourself and our vessels. 

Geometry will always be at the heart of our... aesthetic, but the techniques we employ to fulfil it continue to evolve.

sthera.3.a: Captain [buranCaptain.GetName] takes command of the USS Buran.
sthera.3.desc:
Advances in material sciences coupled with the maturation of Starfleet's exploration mission has resulted in a new generation of Starship designs. Sharp lines have been replaced with graceful curves while space for families and civilian activities has grown substantially. 

While the [Root.GetName] has not left it's defensive technologies behind, the presence of a [Root.GetName] Starship is considered a blessing to the majority of its neighbours. 

The test platform for these new designs - the patrol frigate USS Buran - is now released for standard duties, alongside her commanding officer Captain [buranCaptain.GetName].
sthera.3.desc_evil:
Advances in material sciences coupled with the maturation of Starfleet's exploitation mission have resulted in a new generation of Starship designs. Sharp lines have been replaced with subtle curves while space available for weapons and plunder has grown substantially. 

The [Root.GetName] has not left its defensive technologies behind; the presence of a [Root.GetName] Starship is considered a fearsome sight to the majority of its neighbours. 

The test platform for these new designs - the patrol frigate USS Buran - is now released for standard duties, alongside her commanding officer Captain [buranCaptain.GetName].
sthera.3.name: A Bold New Era
sthera.4.name: A Bold New Era
sthera.5.a.tooltip: The Shipwright - legacy assured - awaits assignment.
sthera.5.desc:
It has been five years since the robed figure entered the Council chamber, clutching a datapad and demanding to speak with [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], refusing to give any name but 'Shipwright'. 

The Shipwright promised to deliver warships of greater power than the Empire has ever known... and now that promise has been delivered. A new generation of ship stands ready to be built, for the glory of the empire.
sthera.5.name: Jaq Chu' Bov
sthera.6.desc:
The Shipwright's warships performed admirably for many years, however untold stories of conquest from millions of cubic lightyears of deep space raid reports and border skirmishes have found their way back to the Imperial Engineering Guild. 

These reports - coupled with improvements from the latest offensive technology - have resulted in a wave of new warship designs fit to face the galaxy, for the glory of the empire.
sthera.6.name: Jaq Chu' Bov
sthera.7.a: General Krex takes command of the IKS Vorcha.
sthera.7.desc:
The galaxy remains a dangerous place, and while Klingon captains continue to prove their skill in battle to enemies of the Empire, the Empire must not become complacent. 

A new breed of warship design has come forth from shipwrights pledged to the House of [Root.GetRulerName], powerful ships built to bring glory to the empire. 

The experimental battleship Vorcha, captained by General Krex, exemplifies the qualities of this new era - overwhelming power and force of presence.
sthera.7.name: Jaq Chu' Bov
sthera.8.desc: A new era of technological superiority awaits for our people, who proudly fight for the glory of the empire.
sthera.8.name: Jaq Chu' Bov
sthera.9.a.tooltip: Commission in hand, Kutaya awaits assignment.
sthera.9.b.tooltip: Commission in hand, Valda awaits assignment.
sthera.9.desc:
Five years the Oversight Committee had waited for the Ministry of War to complete its task. Five years since [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] addressed all Romulus and announced the fifty-seventh Generational Decree - [Root.GetRulerName]'s legacy appended to nearly 2,000 years of Romulan history. A decree to strengthen the Imperial Fleet, to ensure dominance over Vulcan and its new allies. 

Five years of infighting and stalled progress in the Ministry of War. 

Seeing for himself the lack of progress, alien material sciences expert Kutaya - the son of the Flaxian ambassador and a rare non-Romulan favourite of the Imperial Court - instead worked in parallel and in secret with a junior engineer in the Ministry of War, Valda. 

Appearing before the Oversight Committee the pair presented their work. A new generation of warbirds using the latest shields, warp drives and weapons, capable of showing the galaxy at last the true strength of the Romulan Star Empire. 

The Minister of War was furious to see her own work put to shame and stormed from the chamber, a Reman Praetorian guard following with dagger in hand...
sthera.9.name: The Raptor's Wings, Made Anew
stone_of_gol_1.desc:
An ancient device called the 'Stone of Gol' was conceived on Vulcan during the turbulent times before the Time of Awakening.

Finding the first piece is of vital importance.

An ancient device called the 'Stone of Gol' was conceived on Vulcan during the turbulent times before the Time of Awakening.

Until recently it was believed to have been destroyed by the Vulcan gods but in reality, the weapon became disassembled in the Time of Awakening and its three pieces have been scattered over large distances of space.
story.301.desc.borg:
Reports of deep-space drone vessels unattached to the [Root.GetName] in certain systems have been investigated. These drones appear to be the workers and custodians of an autonomous orbital mining operation, established millennia ago and then soon abandoned by all but the drones themselves, judging by the state of the processing equipment.

The drones seem to lack any comms protocols - at least any decipherable by the [Root.GetName] - and react with hostility to [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] ships entering the system. 

Their presence in the [From.From.GetName] system is an inconvenience.
story.305.a.tooltip: Gives access to the Droning Optimizations Edict.
story.305.b.tooltip: Adds a list of mineral-rich planetoids to the Situation Log.
story.305.desc.borg:
The ancient mining drones are indeed primitive, but highly specialised. Mining Network Controller subroutines on [Root.Capital.GetName] indicate efficiencies could be improved by adopting several of their extraction techniques buried in the drone's memory cores; however, this could risk damaging the location data of a number of high-value mining targets nearby. 

Additionally, analysis has indicated that the drones are not completely passive. They emit signal pings, though extremely infrequently and at a wavelength hard to isolate from background noise. There is no indication of what these signals may be targeting.
story.310.desc.borg:
The ancient mining drones were destroyed in a heated battle with [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] vessels. Their energy cores are by far the sturdiest component used in their construction, and some were recovered by the Collective. The technology behind these cells is surprisingly advanced and resistant to assimilation, but initial tests show we are quite capable of converting their output to Energy. 

As the final energy cell bled out, our own drones handling the tests noticed a dip in background radiation. It would appear that the ancient mining drones are not silent, but they have been sporadically broadcasting on unusual frequencies since we first encountered them, possibly ever since they were first deployed. It is unlikely that there is anyone left to receive these transmissions.

The drones could prove to be a potent but limited source of energy, should we be able to find and disable them efficiently enough.
story.330.desc.borg: The [Root.GetName] has encountered a significant Ancient Mining Drone presence in the [From.GetName] system. It appears to be a major mining and mineral processing hub, perhaps the last of its kind in the galaxy.
sword_of_kahless_1.desc: An abandoned base in our own system may hold the key to the location of the Sword of Kahless.
sword_of_kahless_1.name: Hur'q Investigation
sword_of_kahless_2.desc: Dense jungle hides an abandoned medical facility that may help us locate the Sword.
sword_of_kahless_2.name: Jungle Investigation
sword_of_kahless_3.desc: An ancient ocean research station is our next point of call on the quest for the Sword.
sword_of_kahless_3.name: Ocean Investigation
sword_of_kahless_4.desc: We've located one of the last Hur'q colonies in this part of the galaxy. This may be our last option to locate the Sword.
sword_of_kahless_4.name: Desert Investigation
sword_of_kahless_5.desc: Evidence suggests that the Hur'q hid a treasure trove of stolen artefacts here. Is the Sword among them?
sword_of_kahless_5.name: The Vault
sword_of_kahless_chain_desc: The crone Le'tor has found a datapad that may hold clues to the location of the Sword of Kahless, lost centuries ago as the Hur'q were driven from our world.
temp_probe_chain_desc: We discovered a log buoy protected by temporal shields. Unfortunately, we found out after deactivating the shields that the data was too damaged. Maybe we can adjust the scanners to find any more buoys.
terra_prime_chain_desc: The recent string of anti-alien attacks throughout Human space poses a significant threat to our relationships with alien powers. But perhaps it all leads to a much bigger threat to our political system and the way of life.

theFederation.1.desc:
Our interstellar alliance has caught the public imagination. No longer is Earth an isolated backwater on the galactic stage, but a central component in a powerful block of shared values and interests. 

This coalition of planets protects us, but there are many who wish for further integration to better secure ourselves against hostile neighbours. Many influential politicians on coalition worlds have signaled a desire to start this process, all that is needed is for one leader to step forth and make the proposal...

[federationLeader.GetRulerTitle] [federationLeader.GetRulerName] of the [federationLeader.GetName] has formally called on all members of our coalition to take the next step toward integration, through the formation of a true multiplanetary federal state. The 'United Federation of Planets'.

theFederation.1003.desc:
The delegates have all assembled in the grand chamber on [federationLeader.Capital.GetName]. Billions of people from each of the coalition homeworlds watch from their homes or on enormous public displays. 

Federation day! 

[federationLeader.GetRulerTitle] [federationLeader.GetRulerName] steps forward, allied counterparts in tow. Dozens of lights from the audience flash and the roar of the crowd subsides until the entire hall is blanketed in silence. The leaders gather around a large book on the central podium and in turn mark their names. 

'Today is an historic day.', [federationLeader.GetRulerTitle] [federationLeader.GetRulerName] says to the gathered masses.
'Today is the day our many races are joined together in peace, and in the spirit of exploration and progress. Today marks the birth of a federation; THE United Federation of Planets!'

And with that the applause thundered.

Please invite a member world.
theFederation.1200.name: Manage Member World
theFederation.1201.desc: Greetings [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName], I am [selected_member_world.leader.GetName] from [selected_member_world.GetName] how may we assist the Federation today?
theFederation.1201.name: Manage Member World
theFederation.1202.desc: We welcome any additional aid that you can provide [selected_member_world.GetName], but rest assured all our fleets will come to the aid of the Federation should it be required.
theFederation.1202.name: Transfer a Starfleet Fleet
theFederation.1203.desc:
We understand that Starfleet and the Federation require a strong military presence, our Starbase facilities are available to you. 

Should you wish to provide United Federation of Planet's resources to help us upgrade the station it would be appreciated.
theFederation.1203.name: Upgrade a Starbase
theFederation.1205.desc_01: With these funds provided by the Federation Council, we could greatly expand our local fleet. More ships, more personnel, bigger and better training facilities... We would be able to do so much more to help keep the peace.
theFederation.1205.desc_02: In an ever-changing and complex galaxy, security concerns are paramount. Your donation would allow us to scale up our operations and help protect the Federations interests.
theFederation.1205.desc_03: Every additional contribution allows us to expand [selected_member_world.GetName] ability to support our Starfleet forces in keeping peace in the galaxy.
theFederation.1205.desc_04: With this support from the Federation Council, we can ensure we are doing our part to ensure that the Federation is protected and our citizens are safe.
theFederation.1205.desc_05: This contribution provides the maximum reassurance to [selected_member_world.GetName] and other members of the council that the Federation takes the security of its member worlds with the utmost importance.
theFederation.1205.name: Upgrade Fleet Potential
theFederation.1206.desc: Thank you for your support. We are proud to be part of the United Federation of Planets.
theFederation.1206.name: Thank you
theFederation.1207.default: The races of the Milky Way.
theFederation.1207.desc: These are concerning times for all. Our team of strategic problem solvers has a steadfast moral compass and unwavering dedication to creating a safer galaxy. We took great risks to closely monitor situations rising across the galaxy and we believe we can offer the Federation sound tactical advice on the following threats.
theFederation.1207.name: Seek Tactical Support
theFederation.1208.a.response: We are grateful for this boost to our technology, the Federation is truly a generous state.
theFederation.1208.a: We shall share our latest tech.
theFederation.1208.desc: The Federation was formed on the principles of sharing technology and we would embrace this act of support, which will allow us to build the resources of our world and make the Federation stronger as a result.
theFederation.1208.name: Share Technology
theFederation.121.desc: The [From.GetName] have a number of ongoing disputes with their neighbours, and while the Diplomatic Corps would ideally facilitate all mediations it must focus on one at a time.
theFederation.121.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.1210.a.response: We place our security in the hands of the Federation, do not let us down.
theFederation.1210.desc: Transferring our primary Starbase to the control of [Root.GetName] is a major step, we place the ability to defend [selected_member_world.capital_scope.GetName] into the direct responsibility of Starfleet, this is a huge risk for us, but we trust Starfleet, please ensure the safety of our citizens. We would also require compensation in order to build a new Shipyard to ensure that we can continue to construct ships.
theFederation.1210.name: Transfer Starbase
theFederation.1212.c: You should deal with this on your own.
theFederation.1212.desc: Greetings [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName], I am [selected_member_world.leader.GetName] from [selected_member_world.GetName] our capital [selected_member_world.capital_scope.GetName] has become a haven for the criminal underworld, sponsored by those from [target_branch_office_owner.GetName] who would look to profit from our suffering. We implore the aid of Starfleet to resolve this situation.
theFederation.1212.name: Rid Member World of Crime
theFederation.1213.desc: [delivering_aid_leader.GetName] has reported back from [target_branch_office_world.GetName] and has confirmed that a criminal branch office has been opened in this world, raising crime rates and causing harm to the local population of Federation citizens. They recommend reaching out to [target_branch_office_world_owner.GetName] and if that fails sending a force in to clear the branch by force.
theFederation.1213.name: Clearing Crime
theFederation.1214.desc: Attention [Root.GetName] I am contacting you on behalf of the United Federation of Planets, your criminal branch on [target_branch_office_world.GetName] is harming the Federation Citizens of this world, we ask for its immediate removal or we shall take actions into our own hands.
theFederation.1214.name: Incoming Demand!
theFederation.1215.desc: It appears our diplomatic approach has been successful and the branch office has been closed down with minimal fuss, the citizens of this world can once again enjoy life without being hassled by this criminal faction.
theFederation.1215.name: Branch Office Closed
theFederation.1216.desc:
It appears our diplomatic approach has been rejected and the branch office remains open for business. 

At this stage we have little option left, but to send in our forces.
theFederation.1216.name: Branch Office Remains Open!
theFederation.1217.desc: [delivering_aid_leader.GeName] has completed the special operation and closed the branch office down, allowing the citizens of the world to once again go about their lives in peace.
theFederation.1217.name: Branch Office Closed
theFederation.1218.desc: It appears the pirates operating from the Branch Office, have taken badly to being removed from their office and have deployed a pirate fleet to take revenge.
theFederation.1218.name: Ambush
theFederation.122.desc: The head of the Diplomatic Corps has drafted a proposal for a series of summits between the [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] to resolve their ongoing disputes and build trust between both parties.
theFederation.122.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.1220.desc:
The Federation is prepared to invest in the development of [member_world_capital.GetName], providing the funding to build a number of facilities. 

Select the area in which you would like to see development to take place.
theFederation.1220.name: Fund Building Development
theFederation.123.desc: The [From.GetName] has formally offered to help us resolve our dispute with [FromFrom.GetName], lending the full weight of the [From.GetName] Diplomatic Corps behind the initiative.
theFederation.123.name: [From.GetName] Mediation
theFederation.124.desc:
The [From.GetName] has formally offered to help us resolve our dispute with [FromFrom.GetName], lending the full weight of the [From.GetName] Diplomatic Corps behind the initiative. 

The [FromFrom.GetName] have already signalled their willingness to engage in the process.
theFederation.124.name: [From.GetName] Mediation
theFederation.125.desc: The [From.GetName] has rejected our overture to help mediate the dispute between their people and the [FromFrom.GetName].
theFederation.125.name: [From.GetName] - [FromFrom.GetName] Mediation
theFederation.126.desc:
Both the [From.GetName] and the [FromFrom.GetName] have accepted our offer to mediate their dispute. 

A conference will be scheduled on one of the two parties' homeworlds to begin the process.
theFederation.126.name: [From.GetName] - [FromFrom.GetName] Mediation
theFederation.127.desc: While the [From.GetName] was amenable to pursuing talks between their people and the [FromFrom.GetName], the latter have rejected our overture to help mediate the dispute.
theFederation.127.name: [From.GetName] - [FromFrom.GetName] Mediation
theFederation.128.desc: Despite our willingness to engage in the talks, the [FromFrom.GetName] has rejected our overture to help mediate the dispute between our peoples.
theFederation.128.name: [From.GetName] Mediation
theFederation.129.desc: Our mediation of the dispute between the [From.GetName] and the [FromFrom.GetName] has been a success. Both parties have increased their trust of each other.
theFederation.129.name: [From.GetName] - [FromFrom.GetName] Mediation
theFederation.13.b: Perhaps a delay would be beneficial?
theFederation.13.c: The talks should be abandoned for now.
theFederation.13.desc:
The negotiations to welcome [accessionState.Capital.GetName] into the Federation have progressed well, though several issues remain a concern for both parties. The status of the [accessionState.GetSpeciesAdj] Defence Forces and their role within the Starfleet security umbrella in particular have lagged behind fruitful discussions on economic integration. 

It's becoming clear that one final effort is needed from both [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] and [accessionState.GetRulerTitle] [accessionState.GetRulerName] in order to complete the process.
theFederation.13.name: The [accessionState.GetName] and the Federation
theFederation.130.desc: Our failure to honour our commitment to mediate the dispute between the [From.GetName] and the [FromFrom.GetName] by facilitating a conference on [FromFromFrom.GetName] has damaged our relations with both parties, who have seen their trust in us eroded.
theFederation.130.name: [From.GetName] - [FromFrom.GetName] Mediation
theFederation.131.desc:
The [From.GetName] efforts to help resolve our dispute with the [FromFrom.GetName] have been successful after talks on [FromFromFrom.GetName]. 

Relations with the [FromFrom.GetName] have improved, and our trust in the [From.GetName] has also increased.
theFederation.131.name: [From.GetName] Mediation
theFederation.132.desc:
The [From.GetName] efforts to help resolve our dispute with the [FromFrom.GetName] through talks on [FromFromFrom.GetName] have failed after the [From.GetName] failed to attend. 

Relations with the [From.GetName] have suffered as a result.
theFederation.132.name: [From.GetName] Mediation
theFederation.133.desc: Responding to our willingness to engage in the talks, the [FromFrom.GetName] has accepted the [From.GetName]'s offer to help mediate the dispute between our peoples.
theFederation.133.name: [From.GetName] Mediation
theFederation.140.a: This is none of their concern.
theFederation.140.desc: The [From.GetName] has issued a condemnation of our conflict with the [FromFrom.GetName] to the wider galactic community, calling on us to negotiate a peace settlement with the enemy.
theFederation.140.name: [From.GetName] Condemnation
theFederation.141.desc: The [From.GetName] has issued a condemnation of the [FromFrom.GetName] and their conflict against us to the wider galactic community, calling for a swift end to the [FromFrom.GetSpeciesAdj] aggression.
theFederation.141.name: [From.GetName] Support
theFederation.142.b: This is not in our interest.
theFederation.142.desc: The [From.GetName] has committed a modest portion of its diplomatic resources to improve relations with the [Root.GetName].
theFederation.142.name: [From.GetName] Diplomacy
theFederation.143.b: This is not in our interest.
theFederation.143.desc: The [From.GetName] has committed a sizable portion of its diplomatic resources to improve relations with the [Root.GetName].
theFederation.143.name: [From.GetName] Diplomacy
theFederation.144.b: This is not in our interest.
theFederation.144.desc: The [From.GetName] has committed the larger portion of its diplomatic resources to improve relations with the [Root.GetName].
theFederation.144.name: [From.GetName] Diplomacy
theFederation.145.desc: Our efforts to improve relations with the [From.GetName] have borne fruit. Already, formal and informal dialogue between [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] and [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] has increased in frequency.
theFederation.145.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.146.desc: Our efforts to improve relations with the [From.GetName] have borne fruit. Already, formal and informal dialogue between [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] and [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] has increased in frequency.
theFederation.146.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.147.desc: Our efforts to improve relations with the [From.GetName] have borne fruit. Already, formal and informal dialogue between [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] and [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] has increased in frequency.
theFederation.147.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.148.desc: Our efforts to improve relations with the [From.GetName] have failed, with [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of [From.Capital.GetName] publicly mocking our efforts as a sign of weakness.
theFederation.148.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.15.desc: Following the signing of the Federation Charter, a number of influential leaders from each of the founding worlds have stepped forward to join the fledgling United Federation of Planets services and its new deep space exploratory and defense service, Starfleet. From this point forward the Federation members will pool their resources and the best and brightest from each world will be encouraged to serve the Federation and Starfleet Command.
theFederation.15.name: New leaders to join the Federation
theFederation.150.desc:
While the [Root.GetName] believes in peaceful cooperation among all species in the galaxy, there are times when hostilities may only be avoided with the aid of separation. 

By creating a Neutral Zone, tensions can be reduced allowing for diplomatic efforts to begin. 

The diplomatic service has compiled a list of candidate Neutral Zones for consideration. 

Note: Systems along the border of both the [Root.GetName] and the selected government will be temporarily ceded to establish the Neutral Zone.
theFederation.150.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.151.desc:
Relations with the [From.GetName] have been strained recently, and the establishment of a Neutral Zone would go a long way to de-escalate the situation. 

[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] is presented with a number of options for the duration of the proposed Neutral Zone to present [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName] with.
theFederation.151.desc_01:
Tensions with the Romulan Empire reached dangerous levels during the Tomed Incident with fleets actively becoming hostile. The Signing of the Treaty of Algeron forces a peaceful state between the two major powers via the creation of a Neutral Zone. 

[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] is presented with a number of options for the duration of the proposed Neutral Zone to present the Romulan Star Empire with.
theFederation.151.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.152.desc:
Relations with the [From.GetName] have been strained recently. As such, [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName] has proposed the establishment of a Neutral Zone along the shared border, lasting for a period of 25 years. 

Note: Systems along the border of both the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] will be temporarily ceded to establish the Neutral Zone.
theFederation.152.name: Proposed Neutral Zone
theFederation.153.desc:
Relations with the [From.GetName] have been strained recently. As such, [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName] has proposed the establishment of a Neutral Zone along the shared border, lasting for a period of 50 years. 

Note: Systems along the border of both the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] will be temporarily ceded to establish the Neutral Zone.
theFederation.153.name: Proposed Neutral Zone
theFederation.154.desc:
Relations with the [From.GetName] have been strained recently. As such, [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName] has proposed the establishment of a Neutral Zone along the shared border, lasting for a period of 100 years. 

Note: Systems along the border of both the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] will be temporarily ceded to establish the Neutral Zone.
theFederation.154.name: Proposed Neutral Zone
theFederation.155.desc: The [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have agreed to establish a Neutral Zone in order to de-escalate the risk of military confrontation.
theFederation.155.name: [From.GetName] - [FromFrom.GetName] Neutral Zone Established
theFederation.156.desc: The [From.GetName] has rejected [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]'s offer to establish a Neutral Zone in order to de-escalate the risk of military confrontation.
theFederation.156.name: [Root.GetName] - [From.GetName] Neutral Zone Rejected
theFederation.16.desc: Following the signing of the Federation Charter, the founding members agreed to merge their space agencies to establish Starfleet. Starfleet is intended to serve as the United Federation of Planets' deep space exploration and defence organisation. Its main functions are to advance Federation knowledge of the galaxy and its inhabitants, advance Federation science and technology, defend the Federation and facilitate Federation expansion. The first task is to review the ships transferred to Starfleet Command from each species, and to determine whether they should continue to serve or be decommissioned in order to maintain fleet capacity.
theFederation.16.name: Starfleet Command
theFederation.165.desc:
The Neutral Zone separating the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] has been dismantled, following the agreed cut-off date in the establishing treaty. 

Systems ceded to the Neutral Zone have been returned to their previous owners.
theFederation.165.name: [Root.GetName] - [From.GetName] Neutral Zone Dismantled
theFederation.170.desc:
Neutral Zone treaties are written with specific duration limits in place, but if both parties are in agreement there may be opportunities to extend the lifespan of the treaty. 

Additionally, new border locations can be included in the treaty to remove tensions along borders that were created after the initial treaty signing. 

Note: Systems settled along the border of both the [Root.GetName] and the selected government since the initial treaty signing will be temporarily ceded to reinforce the Neutral Zone.
theFederation.170.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.171.desc: The treaty establishing the [From.GetName] has [From.neutralZoneDurationYears] years remaining before it expires.
theFederation.171.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.172.desc:
The [From.GetName] has proposed a 5 year extension to the terms of the treaty establishing the [FromFrom.GetName]. 

Note: Systems settled along the border of both the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] since the original treaty signing will be temporarily ceded to establish the Neutral Zone.
theFederation.172.name: Proposed Neutral Zone Extension
theFederation.173.desc:
The [From.GetName] has proposed a 25 year extension to the terms of the treaty establishing the [FromFrom.GetName]. 

Note: Systems settled along the border of both the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] since the original treaty signing will be temporarily ceded to establish the Neutral Zone.
theFederation.173.name: Proposed Neutral Zone Extension
theFederation.174.desc:
The [From.GetName] has proposed a 50 year extension to the terms of the treaty establishing the [FromFrom.GetName]. 

Note: Systems settled along the border of both the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] since the original treaty signing will be temporarily ceded to establish the Neutral Zone.
theFederation.174.name: Proposed Neutral Zone Extension
theFederation.175.desc:
The [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have agreed to renew the treaty establishing the [FromFromFrom.GetName] in order to de-escalate the risk of military confrontation. 

The terms of the treaty will now expire in [FromFromFrom.neutralZoneDurationYears] years.
theFederation.175.name: [FromFromFrom.GetName] Renewed
theFederation.176.desc:
The [From.GetName] has rejected [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]'s offer to renew the treaty establishing the [FromFrom.GetName]. 

The [FromFrom.GetName] will expire as scheduled in [FromFrom.neutralZoneDurationYears] years.
theFederation.176.name: [FromFrom.GetName] Renewal Rejected
theFederation.180.desc: The Council has approved a number of designs for us to use should we wish to change the iconic design of the Federation Flag.
theFederation.180.name: Update the Federation Flag
theFederation.190.desc: The opportunity has come up to re-look at the borders of the Neutral zones set up across our borders. Systems that border the existing Zone and the other empire will be incorporated into the existing zone.
theFederation.190.name: Re-negotiate a Neutral Zone
theFederation.2.desc:
Our alliance with the Humans and our other neighbours has proven a most logical endeavour. No longer does Vulcan fear the return of those who abandoned Surak's teachings and march beneath the raptor's wings. 

This coalition of planets protects us, but there are many who feel logic dictates further integration to better secure ourselves against hostile neighbours. Politicians on all four worlds have signaled a desire to start this process, all that is needed is for one leader to step forth and make the proposal...
theFederation.2.name: The United Federation of Planets
theFederation.3.desc.isu:
Our alliances have changed the Empire. Gone are the days of endless quarreling and suspicion, now the [Root.GetName] stands at the top of a powerful alliance of worlds, and the potential of this arrangement has caught the public imagination. 

This coalition of planets protects us, but there are many who wish for further integration to better secure ourselves against hostile powers further afield. Debate is split as to the shape of this project, whether it should be a true Federation of equals or a Union focused on [Root.Capital.GetName].

Politicians across the alliance's member worlds have signaled a desire to start this process, all that is needed is for [Root.Capital.GetName] to step forth and make the proposal...
theFederation.3.desc:
Our alliance with the Pinkskins has changed the Empire. Gone are the days of endless quarreling and suspicion, and the potential of this arrangement has caught the public imagination. No longer is Andoria on constant alert against her neighbours, but a central component in a powerful block of shared values and interests. 

This coalition of planets protects us, but there are many who wish for further integration to better secure ourselves against hostile powers further afield. Politicians on all four worlds have signaled a desire to start this process, all that is needed is for one leader to step forth and make the proposal...
theFederation.3.name: The United Federation of Planets
theFederation.4.desc:
Our alliance with the Humans and our other neighbours has caught the public imagination. The arguments have been tremendous, though productive. No longer is Tellar an isolated minor player on the galactic stage, but a central component in a powerful block of shared values and interests. 

This coalition of planets protects us, but there are many who wish for further integration to better secure ourselves against hostile neighbours. Politicians on all four worlds have signaled a desire to start this process, all that is needed is for one leader to step forth and make the proposal...
theFederation.4.name: The United Federation of Planets
theFederation.5.desc:
The delegates have all assembled in the grand chamber on [Root.Capital.GetName]. Billions of people from each of the coalition homeworlds watch from their homes or on enormous public displays. 

Federation day! 

[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] steps forward, allied counterparts in tow. Dozens of lights from the audience flash and the roar of the crowd subsides until the entire hall is blanketed in silence. The leaders gather around a large book on the central podium and in turn mark their names. 

'Today is a historic day.', [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] says to the gathered masses.
'Today is the day our many species are joined together in peace, and in the spirit of exploration and progress. Today marks the birth of a federation; THE United Federation of Planets!'

And with that the applause thundered.
theFederation.5.name: The United Federation of Planets
theFederation.6.desc.1:
Developer Note: 

The other Federation Founders are now a special class of 'Member World' vassal under your nation, which will aid the Federations fleets in times of war.

The Federation Council mechanic has now been unlocked. Once every two years the Federation Council will allow players to integrate new members, reach out to neighbours diplomatically or engage in research specialisation focuses. Furthermore it must now be decided which types of starships to use.
theFederation.6.desc:
Developer Note: 

The other Federation Founders are now a special class of 'Member World' vassal under your nation, which will aid your fleets in times of war.

The Federation Council mechanic has now been unlocked. Once every two years the Federation Council will allow players to integrate new members, reach out to neighbours diplomatically or engage in research specialisation focuses.
theFederation.6.name: The United Federation of Planets
theFederation.90.a: Begin accession talks with potential member worlds.
theFederation.90.c: Expand diplomatic outreach to neighbouring worlds.
theFederation.90.d.tooltip_fail: The [Root.GetName] must have communications with an empire that is at war with a third party.
theFederation.90.desc.isu:
Legislators from across the [Root.GetName], from [Root.Capital.GetName] to [member_world_1.Capital.GetName] have converged on [Root.Capital.GetName] for the Union Council Agenda session every two years. 

[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName] opens the session welcoming the gathered Council Members before passing the floor to [member_world_1.GetRulerTitle] [member_world_1.GetRulerName] of [member_world_1.Capital.GetName]. 

Several hours of policy debate ensue, leaving [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName] to ponder [Root.Leader.GetHerHis] recommendation for the next two years.
theFederation.90.desc_01:
Legislators from across the [Root.GetName], from [member_world_1.Capital.GetName] to [member_world_2.Capital.GetName] have converged on [Root.Capital.GetName] for the Federation Council Agenda session, which is hosted every two years. 

[Root.GetRulerTitle] [federationRuler.GetName] opens the session welcoming the gathered Council Members before passing the floor to [member_world_2.GetRulerTitle] [member_world_2.GetRulerName] of [member_world_2.Capital.GetName]. 

Several hours of policy debate ensue, leaving [Root.GetRulerTitle] [federationRuler.GetName] to ponder [federationRuler.GetHerHis] recommendation for the next two years.
theFederation.90.desc_02: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [federationRuler.GetName] has scheduled an extraordinary session of the Federation Council. Ministers and delegates from across the Federation converge on [Root.Capital.GetName] begin proceedings.
theFederation.90.e: Visit Science Council to adjust research focus.
theFederation.90.g: Call the Council session to a close.
theFederation.90.i.tooltip_fail: The [Root.GetName] must border a normal non-vassal empire with at least 8 owned systems and with an opinion lower than -50, where no existing Neutral Zone is already in place.
theFederation.90.j.tooltip_fail: The [Root.GetName] must have a pre-existing Neutral Zone in place.
theFederation.90.k.tooltip: All Member Worlds will be removed from our pre-existing Alliances if they are part of it.
theFederation.90.k: Remove Member Worlds from our Alliances.
theFederation.90.l.tooltip: Recall any ship currently current on expedition, or locked in a planned activity.
theFederation.90.l: Recall all Ships from active operations.
theFederation.90.m.tooltip: Take ownership of any system owned by the UFP member worlds, except their homesystem.
theFederation.90.n.tooltip: Manage several aspects of the Member Worlds setup, including Starbase level, funds and fleets.
theFederation.90.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.90.o.tooltip: Pedition the council to change the Federation flag to one of a number of available designs from multiple eras.
theFederation.90.q.tooltip: Re-establish the Borders of an existing Neutral Zone.
theFederation.90.s.tooltip: Open the Galactic Diplomacy menu to engage in advanced diplomatic options.
theFederation.90.u.tooltip: Open the menu to manage Federation member worlds and make requests to the assembled UFP Members.
theFederation.91.a.tooltip: Major Empires, as listed on game start screen, can now only be integrated into the UFP if the Federation is relatively more powerful than the empire it is trying to recruit.
theFederation.91.desc.isu:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]'s diplomats have worked tirelessly to lay the groundwork for the accession of new members to Union. 

The following governments have met the high criteria required to be offered the commencement of formal accession negotiations.
theFederation.91.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]'s diplomats have worked tirelessly to lay the groundwork for the accession of new members to Federation. 

The following governments have met the high criteria required to be offered the commencement of formal accession negotiations.
theFederation.91.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.92.a.tooltip:
Undertake low-intensity negotiations to overcome the difficulties in preparing worlds for joining the United Federation of Planets.

An empire's suitability to become a member of the Federation will be marked by their accession progress.
theFederation.92.b.tooltip:
Undertake medium-intensity negotiations to overcome the difficulties in preparing worlds for joining the United Federation of Planets.

An empire's suitability to become a member of the Federation will be marked by their accession progress. This is twice as effective as low-intensity negotiations, but costs:
theFederation.92.c.tooltip:
Undertake high-intensity negotiations to overcome the difficulties in preparing worlds for joining the United Federation of Planets.

An empire's suitability to become a member of the Federation will be marked by their accession progress. This is three times as effective as low-intensity negotiations, but costs:
theFederation.92.desc.isu:
Accession to the [Root.GetName] is a long and detailed process. While basic principles are often agreed early, the minutiae of the Union's legal framework, trade regulations and contributions to the Interstellar Guard often require substantial investments in time and material from the Union government in order to progress. 

The diplomatic service has compiled a list of options available within our resource constraints to fund the process.
theFederation.92.desc:
Accession to the [Root.GetName] is a long and detailed process. While basic principles are often agreed early, the minutiae of the Federation's legal framework, trade regulations and contributions to Starfleet often require substantial investments in time and material from the Federation government in order to progress. 

The diplomatic service has compiled a list of options available within our resource constraints to fund the process.
theFederation.92.e: We lack the resources to begin negotiations.
theFederation.92.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council

Undertake low-intensity negotiations to overcome the difficulties in preparing worlds for joining the United Federation of Planets.

An empire's suitability to become a member of the Federation will be marked by their accession progress.

[From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of [From.Capital.GetName] is attending the Council session and has called for further investment from [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]'s administration to ensure the accession process continues smoothly.

theFederation.94.desc.isu:
Thousands of delegates from across the [From.GetName] have gathered in the grand hall of the imperial palace on [Root.Capital.GetName] to formally sign the accession treaty welcoming [From.Capital.GetName] into the Interstellar Union. 

[From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] stands side by side with [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] and the leaders of other Member Worlds as billions of individuals watch the historic events in public places and homes across the Union.
theFederation.94.desc:
Thousands of delegates from across the [From.GetName] have gathered in the great Council Hall on [Root.Capital.GetName] to formally sign the accession treaty welcoming [From.Capital.GetName] into the Federation. 

[From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] stands side by side with [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] and the leaders of other Member Worlds as billions of individuals watch the historic events in public places and homes across the Federation.
theFederation.94.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.95.desc:
The Federation's primary goal is peaceful coexistence with all races, and to this end the Council is willing to invest a great deal of time and material to improving relations with neighbouring worlds. 

[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] has requested [member_world_1.GetRulerTitle] [member_world_1.GetRulerName] of [member_world_1.Capital.GetName] to lead the committee to compile a list of candidate governments to focus the Federation's diplomatic attention upon.
theFederation.95.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.96.desc.isu:
Conflict anywhere in the galaxy has the risk of spilling over and threatening the Union's safety, and as such there are many in the Council who wish to use the Union's political influence to bring pressure to bear on those who propagate it. 

A panel of Interstellar Guard Admirals has compiled a dossier of ongoing wars in the known galaxy, presenting [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] with the choice on which to focus the Union's diplomatic attention upon.
theFederation.96.desc:
Conflict anywhere in the galaxy strikes against the core of the Federation's principles, and as such there are many in the Council who wish to use the Federation's political influence to bring pressure to bear on those who propagate it. 

A panel of Starfleet Admirals has compiled a dossier of ongoing wars in the known galaxy, presenting [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] with the choice on which to focus the Federation's diplomatic attention upon.
theFederation.96.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.97.desc.isu:
The [From.GetName] - [FromFrom.GetName] war has drawn the particular attention of a number of Council Members, with the Interstellar Guard dossier detailing the origins of the conflict, the casualties so far, and the predicted outcome. 

[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] is presented with a number of options.
theFederation.97.desc:
The [From.GetName] - [FromFrom.GetName] war has drawn the particular attention of a number of Council Members, with the Starfleet dossier detailing the origins of the conflict, the casualties so far, and the predicted outcome. 

[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] is presented with a number of options.
theFederation.97.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.98.a.tooltip: The [From.GetName] receives limited diplomatic overtures and concessions which improves relations between the two empires by +25 for a time.
theFederation.98.b.tooltip:
At the cost of £ -150, the [From.GetName] receives moderate diplomatic overtures and concessions which improves relations between the two empires by +50 for a time.

It also increase their £ influence by +90.
theFederation.98.c.tooltip:
At the cost of £ -300, the [From.GetName] receives large diplomatic overtures and concessions which improves relations between the two empires by +75 for a time.

It also increase their £ influence by +200.
theFederation.98.desc:
Council Members are broadly supportive of improving relations with the [From.GetName], and the initial response from [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] on [From.Capital.GetName] is positive. 

[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] is presented with a range of options for the level of time and resources to be expended through the programme.
theFederation.98.e: We lack the resources to begin negotiations.
theFederation.98.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
theFederation.99.desc:
The pursuit of science is one of the founding principles of the Federation, and as such there are few Council Members who oppose initiatives to facilitate it. 

[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] has requested the support of the academic leadership on [member_world_1.Capital.GetName] to detail a number of research initiatives for the next two years across a number of fields of study.
theFederation.99.e: We lack the resources to fund a research initiative.
theFederation.99.name: [Root.GetSpecialCountryAdjective] Council
the_phage_chain_desc: The Phage has devastated our society. Even a small hope of finding a cure is worth investigating.
