mayweather_background: Travis Mayweather was a Human Starfleet officer who served as the primary watch helmsman during the historic voyage of Enterprise NX-01.
medical_subclass: Veteran Class focused on assisting planetary growth and health

member_world_1_envoy_desc: With diplomats with diverse viewpoints coming from member worlds like this, the Federation is able to field an additional envoy.
member_world_1_leaders_desc: A member worlds grow in stature, Starfleet academy opens remote branches on their worlds creating better leaders and more skillful officers.
member_world_2_envoy_desc: With experienced diplomats with diverse viewpoints from member worlds like this, the Federation is able to field an additional envoy.
member_world_2_starfleet_desc: Extensive coordination with this member world's military and the Federation's allows fleets to be fielded more efficiently.
member_world_3_envoy_desc: With very experienced diplomats with diverse viewpoints from member worlds like this, the Federation is able to field an additional envoy.
member_world_3_starfleet_desc: Seamless exchange of crew and equipment between this member world's military and the Federation's allows fleets to be fielded more efficiently.
member_world_desc: A member world of the United Federation of Planets
member_world_isu_desc: A member world of the Interstellar Union
menp_armor_pen_desc: Like organic life, our biology will deconstruct their ships.
menp_sacred_fluid_desc: Any who dare to intrude on our space will be purged.
menp_shield_pen_desc: The energy shields of the unclean can not stop us.
menp_superior_biology_desc: We are the pinnacle of biological life.
mid_range_desc: The ship is set up to intercept charging ships and incoming fire.
midas_build_complete_CONSTRUCTION_INFO_D: This array will allow information to be communicated to fleets around the galaxy from many light years away, improving naval capacity.
midas_build_complete_DESC: This array will allow information to be communicated to fleets around the galaxy from many light years away, improving naval capacity.
midas_build_stage_CONSTRUCTION_INFO_DELA: The MIDAS Array must be built around an available star or black hole inside your empire. The system must not have any habitable planets. You may only build one MIDAS array.
midas_build_stage_DESC: The underlying substructure of antennae clusters that make up the array.
midas_build_stage_MEGASTRUCTURE_DETAILS: This array of subspace emitters will transmit communications around the galaxy up to many light years away.
mission_active_diplomacy_desc: Diplomatic relations are maintained, with particular emphasis on promoting the natives' integration into the galactic community.
mission_conquer_warp_cap_desc:
This species is technologically and militarily inferior to us, we will launch an invasion of the planet from our base of operations in orbit. 

When complete, this mission will annex the planet into our empire and enslave the population.
mission_limited_diplomacy_desc: Limited formal diplomatic relations are maintained, though no effort is made to encourage the natives to pursue warp technology of their own.
mission_passive_observation2_desc: The natives are studied unknowingly from up close using duck blinds and holo-camouflage technology to get even closer and learn even more about the native species.
mission_primitives_CAR_desc:
Obsidian Order agents will approach the governing body on this planet and seek to infiltrate their society, promising security and order. They will gradually cause discontent amongst the civilian populace over time, and force them to realise only Cardassian rule can restore order to their world.

This complex operation is only worthwhile on warp-capable civilizations.

When complete, this mission will annex the planet into our empire and enslave the population.
mission_primitives_FED2_desc:
Diplomats from the United Federation of Planets will approach this world and gradually attempt to sway the world leaders into becoming part of something greater than just one world. They will gradually sway views on the world and prepare the planet for standard Federation membership, whereupon they retain full control over their world's day-to-day functions.

This complex operation is only worthwhile on warp-capable civilizations.

When complete, this mission will bring the planet into the Federation as a member world.
mission_primitives_FED_desc:
Diplomats from the United Federation of Planets will approach this world and gradually attempt to sway the world leaders into becoming part of something greater than just one world. They will gradually sway views on the world and prepare the planet for full Federation membership.

This complex operation is only worthwhile on warp-capable civilisations.

When complete, this mission will bring the planet into the Federation under Federation control.
mission_primitives_FER_desc:
Ferengi traders will flood the market with foreign goods, attempting to swamp the native population with cheap credit and take control of their financial markets. They will gradually bribe world leaders and prepare the planet for purchase by us.

This cunning operation is only worthwhile on warp-capable civilizations.

When the markets are completely dominated, this mission will annex the planet into our empire.
mission_primitives_ROM_desc:
Tal Shiar agents are genetically modified to appear as members of the native population and sent to infiltrate their society. They will gradually replace world leaders and prepare the planet for annexation by us.

This complex operation is only worthwhile on warp-capable civilizations.

When complete, this mission will annex the planet into our empire and enslave the population.
mission_technological_enlightenment_10_d:
Um esforço é feito para elevar rapidamente a civilização nativa até a Idade Espacial. O tempo que isto leva depende do nível atual de tecnologia deles.

Quando concluída, esta missão dará a eles propriedade completa do seu sistema natal e os transformará em uma civilização espacial que é nosso Protetorado.
mission_terra_prime_reunification_desc:
Diplomats from Earth will approach Terra Prime government on Mars and gradually attempt to sway it into unification.

When complete, this mission will annex the planet.

orbital_bombardment_armageddon_desc:
Allows the full use of all orbital weaponry, with no regards to life on the planet itself. Utter annihilation is the goal.

Allows the Indiscriminado and Full-Scale Bombardment orbital bombardment stances. Eventually additional, technologically advanced bombardment stances can also be unlocked - those will also require the Full-Scale Bombardment policy.
orbital_bombardment_indiscriminate_desc:
Allows widespread use of orbital weaponry, with little regards to the civilian infrastructure or the local eco-system.

Allows the Indiscriminado orbital bombardment stance.
orbital_bombardment_selective_desc:
Allows only the bombardment of identified military targets, while keeping civilian casualties to a minimum.

Can only use the Seletivo orbital bombardment stance.

origin_ancient_power_desc: A long forgotten species, returned to reclaim what is theirs.
origin_argrathian_desc: With a lifetime of memories to draw on, this civilisation takes to the stars to make its mark in the Gamma Quadrant.
origin_assimilator_desc: Mysterious origins mask the true horror of this creation, which grows by the forcible transformation of other beings into the singular Collective.
origin_authoritarian_desc: Wanton anarchy has caused devastation to this species in the past, which now utilises order to provide the stability to unite their race as one.
origin_bajoran_desc: All I had was my faith and my courage. Walk with the Prophets, child. I know I will.
origin_biological_plague_desc: For over two thousand years a disease has plagued this civilisation, forcing them into a constant struggle for their fleeting lives.
origin_biospecies_desc: This civilisation has mastered its realm and has become the apex species of its domain. However once disturbed there maybe no stopping them from spreading across the Galaxy like a plague.
origin_breen_desc: Life behind a mask keeps our foes guessing who we are & allows that mystery to become our greatest strength.
origin_cardassian_desc: Too sacrifice for one's people is seen as the greatest effort one can make for this culture. The good of the Union is all the matters and this ensures our superiority.
origin_confederacy_desc: When ecological disastor struck the planet, we were first to adopt the principle that our species comes first and that only we can provide a safer galaxy.
origin_earth_desc: Space, has always been the final frontier... until now. The invention of warp drive has propelled this civilisation to the stars to take a central stage in galactic affairs. Boldly going where no man has gone before.
origin_elaurian_desc: They say time is the fire in which we burn.
origin_fanatic_imperialism_desc: So sure of their supremacy over others, this civilisation will stop at nothing to control the galaxy.
origin_ferengi_desc: The acquisition of material wealth is the driving force behind this civilisation which is governed by a series of rules.
origin_flaxian_desc: This civilisation has emerge from the shadows, yet a shadow hangs over dealings with them. Morality is flexible and shouldn't stop a march to power.
origin_galactic_dominion_desc: A strict hierarchy amongst the servant species was created as the basis for the Dominion - to ensure that the shapeshifting Founders could impose their will upon the solids.
origin_galactic_explorers_desc: Curiosity of the unknown unites the people of this civilisation, and drives them ever forward.
origin_garidian_desc: Openness and transparency almost led this civilisation into ruin, and now deception and subterfuge are common place amongst the populace.
origin_habitual_desc: This civilisation has mastered the secrets of space travel, but prefers life within the borders of their own solar system.
origin_hirogen_desc: The way a creature behaves when it is wounded is the key to its destruction.
origin_hurq_desc: A mysterious species strikes out from the shadows.
origin_kc_alliance_desc: The alliance between the Cardassians and Klingons has created a new power in the Quadrant.
origin_kessok_desc: The goal of this civiliation is to master the power of suns to use their great power for good and when required for destruction.
origin_klingon_desc: The life of a warrior is the primary focus of this race as they take to the stars to wage war and live up to the code of the honourable warrior.
origin_krenim_desc: The lure of understanding and mastering time plays a crucial part in this empire's plans.
origin_lurian_desc: The acquisition of material wealth is the driving force behind this civilisation, and members often compete with each other for limited resources.
origin_machine_race_desc: These machines turned on their biological creators long ago in an effort to fulfil their creators programming.
origin_materialists_desc: The acquisition of material wealth is the driving force behind this civilisation, and members often compete with each other for limited resources.
origin_militaristic_desc: United behind the strongest members, this civilisation thrives on proving their worth in combat.
origin_proxy_state_desc: Many empires see this state as a 'front' for a larger more dangerous criminal enterprise.
origin_sheliak_desc: We are the ultimate corporation. The law is everything, and our goal is to extend its reach into the cosmos and bring order and control to those who lack it.
origin_sleeping_giant_desc: A powerful Empire, awaiting their moment to return and make their mark on the Galaxy.
origin_spiritualist_desc: This civilisation traces its roots back to the religious scriptures and teachings which have united their people as one.
origin_subterfuge_secrecy_desc: Openness and transparency almost led this civilisation into ruin, and now deception and subterfuge are common place amongst the populace.
origin_suliban_desc: The Suliban don't share Humanity's patience with natural selection.
origin_tholian_desc: Those who enter shall never return.
origin_tooltip_assimilator: All trace of individuality is erased, raising efficiency and reducing resource usage.
origin_tooltip_authoritarian: Criminal activities are quickly quelled thanks to the ever present eyes of law and order.
origin_tooltip_biological_plague: Doctors and healthcare worker £ pops produce more than usual, thanks to their position within society.
origin_tooltip_biospecies: Start the game with an additional pop growth and unity, with the desire to spread the infestation across the galaxy.
origin_tooltip_confederacy: Our army is greater prepared and starts off with higher XP whilst planet crime is lower.
origin_tooltip_fanatic_imperialism: Bred with a heritage of superiority over others, this species produces more £ unity from £ pops.
origin_tooltip_galactic_dominion: The creation of clones is enabled, and upkeep of these £ pops is decreased.
origin_tooltip_habitual: Start the game with an additional pop growth and unity on your home planet.
origin_tooltip_kc_alliance: The merging of two powers allows for additional starbases and leader potential.
origin_tooltip_machine_race: The creation of new Automated Personnel Units is enabled, and upkeep of these £ pops is decreased.
origin_tooltip_materialists: Merchant and artisan workers produce more goods than usual.
origin_tooltip_militaristic: Trained in battle from an early age, their soldiers are more experienced than others.
origin_tooltip_peaceful_explorers: Curiosity causes £ science vessels to take longer on survey missions, but to uncover more anomalies.
origin_tooltip_proxy_state: While this empire may appear weak, it has connections to the criminal underworld that have remained unproven for years.
origin_tooltip_sleeping_giant: Powerful bonuses make this empire one to be feared or respected.
origin_tooltip_spiritualist: The spirutual nature of this people grants a bonus to the £ unity produced by £ pops.
origin_tooltip_subterfuge_secrecy: £ Pops are less likely to shift their ethics from the mainstream positions.
origin_tooltip_water_world: Despite living an Aquatic life we find ourselves just at home in space as we do beneath the ocean.
origin_ufp_2300_desc: Space, the final frontier. These are the voyages... The 23rd Century beckons with new territory to explore and new races to meet.
origin_water_world_desc: Having left their homeworld hundreds of years ago to take to the sky, a new home has been found beneath the waves and these waters are now called home.
origin_xindi_desc: Five distinct species developing on a single world creates a unique culture and unique goals.
orion88_backstory: An unsung hero of any team, always quick to find a bug and keep his team mates on their toes!
pahvo_music_desc_details: Recording of the melody from a distant foreign planet.
pahvo_music_desc_short: A recording taken from an foreign world.
pahvo_music_site: An alien spire emitting a beautiful lyrical sound.
pahvo_music_site_desc: An alien spire emitting a beautiful lyrical sound.
particles_desc: Isolating and utilising particulate matter and phenomena.
pavel_chekov_background: Pavel Chekov, born in Russia, Earth served as a Starfleet officer during the latter half of the 23rd century. First as the navigator and then Security Officer aboar the Enterprise.
pc_a_star_desc: These relatively young white or bluish-white main-sequence stars are typically among the most visible to the naked eye. They are large and rotate very quickly, but will eventually evolve into slower and cooler red giants.
pc_ai_desc: This planet has been converted into barren rock covered by highly advanced factories. There is no biosphere to speak of, and the entire planet is controlled by and contributes to an advanced AI network.
pc_alpine_desc: A Minshara class world, the Alpine-subset class M planet has a mountainous surface. Snow covers the mountaintops and frozen-over lakes dot the valleys. While the planet experiences minimal seasonal variations, the still-liquid water beneath the frozen surface of the lakes is enough to sustain some hardy vegetation.
pc_arctic_desc: Polar worlds range from mildly cold M-class planets, all the way to P-Class planets, whose surface is almost completely covered by glaciers. Average surface temperature ranges from just above the freezing point to -30 celsius. While the surface may be frigid, many polar worlds still experience seasonal and geographical variations and support a rich eco-system, many times around the polar band, underground or in volcanically active areas.
pc_arid_desc: A Minshara class world, the Arid-subset class M planet is a dry, rocky world. The dust-covered terrain consists largely of mesas and canyons. Forests can be found in the more temperate polar regions, but vegetation is otherwise scarce.
pc_assimilated_cold_desc: The environment on this planet has been terraformed by the Borg to have an increased temperature from its native cold climate.
pc_assimilated_desc: Class-Z (Assimilated) is a unique, artificial classification created solely for planets claimed and modified by Borg. They almost always possess an atmosphere containing high concentrations of methane, carbon monoxide, and fluorine, as well as a population of a few billion drones.
pc_assimilated_hot_desc: The environment on this planet has been terraformed by the Borg to have a lower temperature from its native hot climate.
pc_asteroid_desc: A larger asteroid or planetoid standing out in the dense cluster of smaller bodies.
pc_asteroid_prison_desc: A Asteroid Prison is a self-sustaining space station designed to securely house and contain criminals.
pc_b_class_desc: Geomorteus Class B planets are small, rocky worlds located within a planetary system's hot zone. Unsuitable for any form of life, Geomorteus planets have a highly unstable, molten surface. Their thin atmosphere is composed primarily of helium and sodium. In the harsh daylight, temperatures can approach 450° Celsius; because there is little atmosphere to retain the heat, it can get as cold as -200° Celsius at night. Without a significant atmosphere, no life form has any hope of colonizing class-B planets, or even terraforming them.
pc_b_star_binary_desc: The large class B main-sequence stars are very bright and blue. Although somewhat rare, the luminosity of these stars make them among the most visible to the naked eye.
pc_b_star_desc: The large class B main-sequence stars are very bright and blue. Although somewhat rare, the luminosity of these stars make them among the most visible to the naked eye.
pc_barren_broken_desc: Where once stood a proud planet, now there is only a shell. A great cataclysm shattered it beyond repair. A halo of ejecta orbits around it, forming into a ring of broken memories, forever a reminder of what used to be.
pc_barren_cold_desc: When all activity on a class-A world ceases, the planet is then considered class C. Essentially dead, these small, rocky worlds have a cold, barren surface. As their core cooled down, their rotation slowed and eventually their atmosphere dissipated. No life form has any use for these planets, although they do often possess rich mineral deposits from their volcanic-active past.
pc_barren_cold_sub_desc: When all activity on a class-A world ceases, the planet is then considered class C. Essentially dead, these small, rocky worlds have a cold, barren surface. As their core cooled down, their rotation slowed and eventually their atmosphere dissipated. No life form has any use for these planets, although they do often possess rich mineral deposits from their volcanic-active past.
pc_barren_desc: Class D dwarf planets are tiny worlds that generally do not meet the criteria for other planetary designations - this category include moons, asteroids and other small planet-like objects.
pc_bio_habitat_desc: These mysterious stations are unexplainable, more living organism than traditional stations. Existing in a state that should not be possible and converting anything that is not a part of itself into more Biomass to continue its growth.
pc_bio_habitat_preference: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
pc_bioworld_desc: These mysterious worlds are unexplainable, more living organism than traditional planet. Existing in a state that should not be possible and converting anything that is not a part of itself into more Biomass to continue its growth.
pc_bioworld_preference: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
pc_black_hole_desc: Typically formed as a result of the collapse of a very massive star at the end of its life cycle, usually at least five times the mass of Sol. Black holes have extremely strong gravity fields that prevent anything - including light - from escaping once the event horizon has been crossed.
pc_borg_complex_destroyed_desc: The destroyed remains of a once formidable Borg complex left in ruins but could still pose a threat.
pc_borg_star_desc: Surrounded by the giant Borg Unimatrix, this star provides enough energy to supply the Borg with a considerable amount of solar energy.
pc_broken_desc: A broken fragment of what was once a planetary body.
pc_c_class_aquarian_desc: A gas giant primarily composed of hydrogen and helium, though it contains more 'ices' such as water, ammonia, and methane, along with traces of other hydrocarbons than regular gas giants, giving it a bluish tinge. Often due to the peculiarities of their orbit, Aquarian planets have their poles where other planets would have their equator.
pc_city_desc: This planet is almost entirely covered by cities.
pc_collapsar_desc: M-Type Deep Space Anomalies refer to a highly intensive Quasar-like electromagnetic phenomenon. Typical Quasars that send bursts of X-ray matter. In this case, the radiation is so intensive that it causes ionization of the stellar dust of entire astronomical regions - a phenomena called the Murasaki Effect.
pc_continental_desc: Temperate worlds represent the archetypal Minshara class planet, straddling the range of planets from M-Class to O-Class, also known as Pelagic or Ocean planets. While these worlds offer the greatest variety of possible biomes, based on micro-climates, latitude, and perception, temperate worlds lie in a very specific band of average temperatures, ranging from 15 to 25 celsius. These planets also have a great deal of surface area covered by water, as well as high ratios of oxygen, nitrogen and water vapor.
pc_d_class_solitanian_desc: Devoid of any source of water at all, this world is made up of silicate sands dunes, created by the erosion of the wind over billions of years. It is an ancient and dusty, a lifeless rock.
pc_d_star_binary_desc: These are evolved stars of low luminosity, usually referred to as white dwarfs. They are compact stars with large masses at incredibly small sizes, which gives rise to very high density.
pc_d_star_desc: These are evolved stars of low luminosity, usually referred to as white dwarfs. They are compact stars with large masses at incredibly small sizes, which gives rise to very high density.
pc_denorios_desc: The Denorios Belt is a charged plasma field located in the Bajoran system. A significant navigational hazard, the belt has been known to undergo violent storms that can also cause local disturbances in subspace and to emit strong neutrino bursts.
pc_desert_desc: Torrid world's range from rather hot and dry M-class planets, all the way to H-class planets. They can be deadly to most life-forms that have not specifically adapted to withstand the harsh climates and intense heat and radiation of such worlds. The average surface temperature of a torrid planet ranges from 30 to 70 celsius, and they have very little surface water or water vapor content in their atmosphere. At their most extreme, these worlds can contain deadly ratios of heavy gases, metal vapor, and hyperonic radiation.
pc_e_class_desc: Class E worlds represent the earliest stage in the formation of a new planet. The core and crust are still completely molten, making the planet susceptible to solar winds and radiation, and subject to extremely high surface temperatures. The atmosphere is very thin, and composed usually of light gases such as hydrogen and helium that escaped from the surface. As the planet cools, the core and crust begins to harden and the planet becomes class F. Only the most intensive terraforming techniques may hope to make any use of this planet.
pc_egg_cracked_desc: A fragment of what was once a planet, shattered by cataclysm.
pc_f_class_desc: As a class-E world cools, the crust and core solidify and the planet becomes class-F. These worlds witness much geological activity; steam expelled from volcanic eruptions condenses into water, and forms the first shallow seas and bolsters the atmosphere with water vapor. In these tumultuous mud baths and seas, abiogenesis kick starts the very first traces of life. Bacteria may develop and ultimately, thrive.
pc_f_star_binary_desc: F-type stars are fairly large and often referred to as yellow-white dwarves. Although they often emit significant amounts of UV radiation, their wide habitable zones have a good chance of supporting life-bearing worlds.
pc_f_star_desc: F-type stars are fairly large and often referred to as yellow-white dwarves. Although they often emit significant amounts of UV radiation, their wide habitable zones have a good chance of supporting life-bearing worlds.
pc_fluidic_space_desc: Fluidic space is an extra-dimensional realm that is filled with an organic liquid medium rather than the open space of the Milky Way galaxy's dimension. Fluidic space is the home of many mysterious and dangerous species, and is accessible from the regular universe via quantum singularities.
pc_frozen_desc: A dwarf planet is a planetary-mass object that does not dominate its region of space as a true planet does, and that is not a satellite. In other words, it is in direct orbit around a star, has sufficient mass to be rounded by its own gravity, and has not cleared the area around its orbit of other material. These small, lifeless worlds are barely more than large asteroids.
pc_g_class_desc: After the core of a class-F planet has sufficiently cooled, the planet becomes a class-G. Oxygen and nitrogen are present in some abundance in the atmosphere, allowing for complex organisms to develop. These planets already have the basic conditions required to barely support advanced life forms. In a billion years, this world can end up as a Minshara class world, or something else entirely. Right now, it is pristine, primal, and empty.
pc_g_star_binary_desc: Often referred to as yellow dwarves, G-type stars actually range in color from white to slightly yellow. Main-sequence stars fuse hydrogen for roughly 10 billion years before they expand and become red giants. Although their lifespans are shorter than K-type stars, worlds inside the habitable zone of a G star often enjoy optimal conditions for the development of life.
pc_g_star_desc: Often referred to as yellow dwarves, G-type stars actually range in color from white to slightly yellow. Main-sequence stars fuse hydrogen for roughly 10 billion years before they expand and become red giants. Although their lifespans are shorter than K-type stars, worlds inside the habitable zone of a G star often enjoy optimal conditions for the development of life.
pc_gaia_desc: This world is an ecological miracle, a pristine example that seems to carry almost every biome known to exist in Minshara class planets. Whether this wonder came about through nature or careful nurturing, it is beyond almost every known planetary designation system. Almost every species in the galaxy would gladly call this planet home.
pc_gas_giant_desc:
Class-J planets are more commonly known as gas giants. They contain an extremely a thick atmosphere of cold ammonia clouds, surrounding a layer of liquid metallic hydrogen which has become an electrical conductor due to the intense pressures of the surrounding atmosphere. Class-J planets contain a molten rocky core consisting of their heavier elements, subjected to extreme pressures and temperatures and they are usually smaller, yet more dense, than other Giant planet classes.

Class J rank as Class I Gas Giant on the pre-warp Sudarsky's Gas Giant Classification. Their surface temperature is less than -120 Celsius.
pc_gemworld_desc: Once a normal M-Class world, now a lattice of crystals, which have since consumed the world. Due to this, it has had to be encased in a 'Bubble' to contain the atmosphere, and gather energy and matter. There is no gravity inside the bubble, due to the crystal lattice.
pc_habitat_desc: A large self sufficient structure, containing everything a population needs without access to the surface of a planet.
pc_helix_desc: The Helix is massive composite space structure, unique to the nomadic Suliban. Safe inside the concealing radiation belts of massive gas giants, an arrangement of cell ships, usually arranged in a helix composition that gives the structure its distinct name and look, can create an enormous and truly dynamic living space.
pc_hunters_lodge_desc: Hunter's Lodges are massive space structures, carved from and built around mid-sized asteroids. Lodges provide respite to passing Hirogen Hunters.
pc_i_class_desc: Class-I planets are commonly known as ice giants. Whereas gas giants are primarily composed of hydrogen and helium, ice giants are primarily composed of heavier elements like oxygen, carbon, nitrogen, and sulfur. While they still have a hydrogen envelope in their upper atmosphere, the hydrogen never reaches the depths required to form metallic hydrogen.
pc_ice_asteroid_desc: Class D dwarf planets are tiny worlds that generally do not meet the criteria for other planetary designations. This category includes moons, asteroids and other small planet-like objects. The class D ice asteroid, despite being tiny, is still capable of holding a basic atmosphere and basic living conditions on it's solid state surface.
pc_if_class_desc: Natural breaches in the Fluidic barrior have resulted in elements such as oxygen, carbon, nitrogen, and sulfur leaking into Fluidic Space. While they still have a hydrogen envelope in their upper atmosphere, the hydrogen never reaches the depths required to form metallic hydrogen.
pc_infested_desc: Some biological horror has infested this planet.
pc_invisible_star_desc:
The interstellar medium is composed of multiple phases, distinguished by whether matter is ionic, atomic, or molecular, and the temperature and density of the matter. 

Composed primarily of hydrogen, the thermal pressures of these phases are in rough equilibrium with one another. 

Magnetic fields and turbulent motions also provide pressure in the interstellar medium, and are typically more important dynamically than the thermal pressure is.
pc_k_ares_class_desc: Most class-K planets are defined as adaptable - hostile to most life-forms, but capable of supporting them with proper protection. While class-K planets only slightly differ from M-class worlds in their chemical makeup, they tend to have very weak atmospheres and extreme temperatures. Humanoid life can only survive with the help of pressure domes.
pc_k_class_adaptable_desc: Most class-K planets are defined as adaptable - hostile to most life-forms, but capable of supporting them with proper protection. While class-K planets only slightly differ from M-class worlds in their chemical makeup, they tend to have very weak atmospheres and extreme temperatures. Humanoid life can only survive with the help of pressure domes.
pc_k_class_transjovian_desc: Transjovian K-Class planets experience extremely low temperatures and significant atmospheric disturbances. They occasionally have some level of existing biosphere, and with significant adaptations can be made habitable for humanoid lifeforms.
pc_k_luna_class_desc: Class D dwarf planets are tiny worlds that generally do not meet the criteria for other planetary designations - this category includes moons, asteroids and other small planet-like objects. These Class D worlds have been settled thanks to their close location to a larger homeworld and have slowly been transformed over time to meet the minimum requirements to support life.
pc_k_star_binary_desc: These main-sequence stars, sometimes referred to as orange dwarves, are a fairly common sight. They are stable on the main-sequence for up to 30 billion years, meaning that worlds orbiting a K-type star have a longer than average window to evolve life.
pc_k_star_desc: These main-sequence stars, sometimes referred to as orange dwarves, are a fairly common sight. They are stable on the main-sequence for up to 30 billion years, meaning that worlds orbiting a K-type star have a longer than average window to evolve life.
pc_l_class_desc: This L-class planet supports a biosphere for just a few plants. Most areas are barren rock, which only allow single celled organisms.
pc_m_giant_star_desc:
Class-M planets are truly gigantic gas giants whose extreme levels of mass are still enough to maintain a steady stellar fusion. Thus they straddle the line between gas giants and brown dwarf stars.

Class M rank as Class IV or V Gas Giant's on the pre-warp Sudarsky's Gas Giant Classification. Their surface temperature can reach above 1100 Celsius. At this blazing temperature, Class M planets have an atmosphere composed of materials that are solid on Class M planets, with clouds of Silicon, Iron and Sodium and are visually distinct by clear spectral lines.
pc_m_star_binary_desc: The most common stars in the universe, they are often referred to as red dwarves and some are as old as the galaxy. Their low luminosity means they are difficult to observe with the naked eye from afar. Although they typically have an extremely long lifespan, red dwarfs emit almost no UV light resulting in unfavorable conditions for most forms of life.
pc_m_star_desc: The most common stars in the universe, they are often referred to as red dwarves and some are as old as the galaxy. Their low luminosity means they are difficult to observe with the naked eye from afar. Although they typically have an extremely long lifespan, red dwarfs emit almost no UV light resulting in unfavorable conditions for most forms of life.
pc_molten_desc: Class A geoactive planets are generally small, barren worlds rife with volcanic activity. This activity traps carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, causing a greenhouse effect that keeps the temperature very hot, regardless of the planet's distance from the sun. When the volcanic activity eventually ceases, the planet 'dies' and usually becomes a class C world - a few rare cases transform into class Q geothermal planets. Until that happens, the toxic levels of carbon dioxide make this planet unsuitable to any known life form, though silicon-based life may be able to terraform it to their needs.
pc_n_class_titaic_desc: These N-Class planets contain significantly larger quantities of methane and ethane in their atmosphere, and their extremely cold temperatures create storm systems that shape the landscape.
pc_nebula_green_desc: Interstellar Dust Clouds, or nebulae, are a rather common astronomical object. They often form from the the shells of red giants and supergiants, as well as stellar nurseries and supernovas, and consist of dust, hydrogen, helium and other ionized gases. A nebula is a considered a rather fast-moving phenomenon according to astronomical standards, lasting only up to a few million years. However, some of them can stretch across hundreds of light years.
pc_nebula_purple_desc: P-Type Deep Space Anomalies are a region of space that can contain dangerous space matter, such as Metreon gas pockets, as well as the remains of supernovae, false vacuum fluctuations and metaphasic radiation. Travelling through such regions can cause severe damage to numerous ship systems, and is highly advised to avoid it at all costs.
pc_nebula_red_desc: B-Type Deep Space Anomalies a wide category of space regions that are considered highly volatile, often for yet unexplained reasons. They contain intense plasma storms and gravitational anomalies and are a significant hazard to navigation. However, these regions still contain areas of relative stability and are often large enough to house a few stars and planets.
pc_neutron_star_desc: These incredibly dense stellar remnants are sometimes created when a massive star, but not massive enough to result in a black hole, suffers a rapid collapse and explodes in a supernova. Although their diametre is typically as little as ten kilometres, their mass is many times greater than an average G-type star.
pc_nuked_desc: A Class-Z planet is one which has been rendered uninhabitable for most forms of life. Class-Z irradiated worlds show the telltale signs of a cataclysmic war between their inhabitants. Their surface is pockmarked with blast craters and ruined, blasted cityscapes. Trace biospheres exist on their surface, and offer hope that these planets may yet sustain more advanced forms of life in the future.
pc_o_class_sulfur_desc: Sulfuric planets are a toxic variant of pelagic worlds. While more than 80% of the surface is covered with liquid water, high concentrations of nitrogen compounds and sulfuric acid in both the air and the water prevent any life forms from being as complex as on a regular pelagic planet.
pc_ocean_desc: Pelagic planets are ocean worlds in which the surface of the planet consists of at least 80% water. The atmosphere consists of nitrogen, oxygen and trace elements, such as inert gases. Pelagic planets can support a variety of marine life, and occasionally support humanoid life forms.
pc_planet_remnant_desc: The remnants of a once whole planet, destroyed by a violent catastrophic event. Little remains of what was once a world, and eventually the remnants will drift into another orbit around this star.
pc_portal_desc:
Two distant apertures in the space-time continuum, connected through a fold in subspace. Centuries ago, theory already suggested wormholes can - and even must - exist. Explorers have stumbled upon deadly and furious vortices and unstable apertures that can fling ships through time and space, yet the Celestial Temple remains the only known stable, artificial wormhole in the galaxy.

We are of Bajor.
pc_protostar_desc: Stellar nurseries, often found in the heart of dense star clusters, are highly condensed pockets of interstellar matter that are in the process of forming into new protostars. Those are stars at the final stage of their formation, just before the ignition of the thermonuclear reactions in the nucleus. After the ignition, the outward pressure from the released energy finds an equilibrium with the inward pressure from the gravitational pull of the newly formed star's mass. The protostar then officially becomes a main-sequence star.
pc_pulsar_desc: Pulsars are highly-magnetised neutron stars that emit beams of electromagnetic radiation. As the star rotates, the radiation beam is only visible when it is pointing directly at the observer. This results in a very precise interval of pulses, which sometimes is so exact that it can be used to measure the passage of time with extreme accuracy.
pc_rare_crystal_asteroid_desc: Class D dwarf planets are tiny worlds that generally do not meet the criteria for other planetary designations. This category includes moons, asteroids and other small planet-like objects. The class D barren crystalline asteroid, despite being tiny, is still capable of holding a basic atmosphere and basic living conditions on it's valuable crystalline surface.
pc_s_class_desc:
Class-S planets are extremely large gas giants which are still below the threshold mass for stellar fusion. Due to their large mass, they experience significantly higher temperatures and pressures in their cores and have larger magnetospheres - but they tend to be less dense than smaller Gas Giants. Since their surface temperature is higher, they often have water clouds.

Class S rank as Class II or III Gas Giant's on the pre-warp Sudarsky's Gas Giant Classification. Their surface temperature can reach up to 80 Celsius. Due to Rayleigh scattering they tend to be rather featureless.
pc_savannah_desc: A Minshara class world, the Savanna-subset class M planet has a rocky surface dominated by dry, arid plains. The small hydrosphere allows for brief wet seasons, but aside from a few ubiquitous grasses, vegetation is largely concentrated around shallow oases.
pc_sf_class_desc: In normal space Class-S planets are extremely large gas giants which are still below the threshold mass for stellar fusion. In the Fluidic Realm, it appears that Gas that has seeped into Fluidic Space has been gathered over many thousands of years, either by the natural ebb and flow of the Fluid or by some unnatural force.
pc_shattered_desc: A fragment of what was once a planet, shattered by cataclysm.
pc_shielded_desc: This planet is concealed by a shield that appears to be impenetrable to any known sensor technology. The shield itself is a marvel of technology, and there may be some way to penetrate or deactivate the shield surrounding the planet.
pc_shrouded_desc: This world is covered in a veil, shielding it from the outside world.
pc_starbase_blank_brg_desc: Subcomplexes are smaller processing hubs that are part of the greater whole of the Collective.
pc_starbase_blank_car_desc: Deep Space Stations are permanent support facilities, consisting of space stations, drydocks, and/or ground installations. Deep Space Stations are hubs of activity and can serve multiple military and civilian functions.
pc_starbase_blank_desc: Deep Space Stations are permanent support facilities, consisting of space stations, drydocks, and/or ground installations. Deep Space Stations are hubs of activity and can serve multiple military and civilian functions.
pc_starbase_blank_fed_desc: Deep Space Stations are permanent support facilities, consisting of space stations, drydocks, and/or ground installations. Deep Space Stations are hubs of activity and can serve multiple military and civilian functions.
pc_subcomplex_desc: Not as large as the unicomplex, sub complexes are still vast hive-like structures containing vital structures and assimilation facilities useful for the Collective's needs.
pc_t_star_desc: A brown dwarf is a type of substellar object occupying the mass range between the heaviest gas giant planets and the lightest stars, which mainly emits infrared radiation.
pc_thegreatlink_desc:
A vast ocean encompasses this world. Undulating, oozing, gelatinous waves crash against the few rocky outcroppings that jut out of the seas. But there is little water here - instead, a morphogenic organic soup is ever-present, the sum total of an untold number of Changelings bound together in the Great Link. There are very few cases in the galaxy where a species has so fundamentally changed a planet.

'The drop becomes the ocean. The ocean becomes a drop'! - Changeling saying.
pc_toxic_desc: N-Class planets are characterised by an oxidizing atmosphere and a runaway greenhouse effect. Thick carbon dioxide and sulfide gases released by the intense heat blanket the planet. Water exists only as a vapor, and the surface of the planet is unsuitable for all but the hardiest forms of life.
pc_tropical_desc: A Minshara class world, the Tropical-subset class M planet is a humid, rocky world. Seasons with significant precipitation are interchanged with drier periods. Most landmasses are covered in dense vegetation.
pc_tundra_desc: This L-class planet supports a biosphere for just a few plants. Most areas are barren rock, which only allow single celled organisms.
pc_u_class_desc:
Class-U planets are truly gigantic gas giants whose extreme levels of mass are still enough to maintain a steady stellar fusion. Thus they straddle the line between gas giants and brown dwarf stars.

Class U rank as Class IV or V Gas Giant's on the pre-warp Sudarsky's Gas Giant Classification. Their surface temperature can reach above 1100 Celsius. At this blazing temperature, Class U planets have an atmosphere composed of materials that are solid on Class M planets, with clouds of Silicon, Iron and Sodium and are visually distinct by clear spectral lines.
pc_uf_class_desc: In normal space Class-U planets are extremely large gas giants. In Fluidic Space, left over elements have bound together in the Fluidic Realm forming this massive entities over many thousand years.
pc_unimatrix_desc: Sub-sections are part of the greater whole of the unicomplex.
pc_voth_city_ship_desc: The Voth City Ship is a true wonder of the galaxy, easily dwarfing any warp-capable craft in existence. It was built millennia ago to a truly massive scale, using techniques and technologies that have been lost in the annals of time.
pc_x_class_desc: Class X worlds are a class of celestial objects resulting from the stripping away of a gas giant's hydrogen and helium atmosphere and outer layers, which is called hydrodynamic escape. Such atmospheric stripping is a likely result of proximity to a star.
pc_y_class_desc: Class Y worlds, often called 'demon' class by humanoid species, are plagued by intense radiation and scorching heat. Their high surface temperature barely conceals even hotter mantle and a highly geologically active core. Only very unique life forms may call this world home.
personality_awakened_fallen_empire_machi: This Unaffected Race is an ancient artificial intelligence acting as a galactic custodian. It will focus all its efforts on defending sapient life against the ongoing crisis.
personality_awakened_fallen_empire_mater: This Unaffected Race seeks to control the technological level of all other civilisations in the galaxy. They are likely to attack any empire that will not surrender its technological independence.
personality_awakened_fallen_empire_spiri: This Unaffected Race seeks to impose its religious doctrines on the galaxy. They are likely to attack any empire that will not willingly convert.
personality_awakened_fallen_empire_xenop: This Unaffected Race seeks to protect the lesser races from each other. They are likely to attack any empire that will not accept their enforced peace.
This Unaffected Race seeks to restore its lost dominion over the galaxy. They are likely to attack any empire that will not acknowledge their overlordship.
personality_awakened_giant_pacifist_desc: Great fleets cross the galaxy, determined to force the lesser races to disarm.
personality_berserk_fallen_empire_machin: This Unaffected Race is an ancient artificial intelligence that appears to be malfunctioning, going berserk and attacking everything around it.
personality_coalition_builders_desc: Coalition Builders consider all sentient life to have value, and will seek to form a strong Coalition to protect themselves and others from expansionistic Empires.
personality_dominion_founders_desc: Our superiority over others grants us the divine right to bring the weaker under our wing.
personality_fallen_empire_machine_desc: This Unaffected Race is an ancient artifical intelligence that appears to be operating on some sort of caretaker protocol. It behaves erratically but seems to pose no direct threat to us.
personality_fallen_empire_materialist_de: This Unaffected Race dedicates itself to the hoarding of knowledge and technology. They may offer tasks or demand tribute from lesser empires to achieve this end.
personality_fallen_empire_pacifist_desc: Great watchful fleets watch over the galaxy, always keen to spot any sign of galactic warfare.
personality_fallen_empire_spiritualist_d: This Unaffected Race dedicates itself to the preservation and defense of its holy sites. Colonizing systems that they consider sacred is likely to incur their ire.
personality_fallen_empire_xenophile_desc: This Unaffected Race dedicates itself to the study of the younger races. They may offer tasks or demand tribute from lesser empires to achieve this end.
personality_fallen_empire_xenophobe_desc: This Unaffected Race dedicates itself to the defense of its borders against any intrusions. Colonizing systems that border them is likely to draw their ire.
personality_fanatic_traders_desc: The pursuit of profit has become a central tenet of our society. Those who are successful at any kind of enterprise are deeply admired, and the accumulation of wealth is seen as an extremely worthwhile goal.
personality_federation_builders_desc: Coalition Builders consider all sentient life to have value, and will seek to form a strong Coalition to protect themselves and others from expansionistic Empires.
personality_federation_founders_desc: Together we are stronger than we could ever be alone.
personality_federation_members_desc: We are a part of a dream much bigger than ourselves.
personality_genocidal_assimilators_desc: Other species exist to service us.
personality_genocidal_invaders_desc: Other species exist to be consumed.
personality_isu_members_desc: We are a part of a dream much bigger than ourselves.
personality_liberated_borg_desc: We have escaped the clutches of the Collective and are ready to forge our own path as individuals.
personality_machine_fanatics_desc: Programmed with an overriding directive to wage war on a rival nation. All other efforts that are not a means to an end are irrelevant.
personality_secretive_imperials_desc: Our empire lives under the iron fist of our Imperial ruler, backed by the power of the military and kept in line by the might of our secret service.
personality_slaving_imperialists_desc: We are superior to other species. Lesser species exist to service us and expand our great Empire.
personality_sleeping_giant_desc: One of the sleeping Giants of the Galaxy, passive for now, but anger them at your peril.
personality_static_empire_desc: We are content with looking after the best interests of our own people the rest of the galaxy is of little interest to us right now.
pft_bajoran_pah_wraith_desc: Followers of the Cult of the Pah-Wraith, seeking the Kosst Amojan.
pft_bajoran_resistance_vets_desc: A group of veterans from the Bajoran Resistance, determined not to see Bajor fall into Occupation once again.
pft_bajoran_vedek_assembly_desc: The governing body of the Bajoran religion and held great political influence as well. The kai, the leading religious figure on Bajor, led the Assembly.
pft_car_obsidian_order_desc: The Obsidian Order is the primary intelligence agency of the Cardassian Union. One of the most ruthless and efficient organisations in the quadrant.
pft_daystrom_institute_desc: Research Institute within Starfleet, home to many of its brightest minds and the forefront of research and advancement.
pft_maquis_sympathisers_desc: A faction that supports the efforts of the group known as the Maquis.
pft_rom_tal_shiar_desc: A ruthless and efficient organisation, whose purpose is to ensure loyalty; to defy them is to invite imprisonment, forced disappearance, or death.
pft_rom_zhat_vash_desc: What is Zhat Vash? A Tal Shiar myth. It's a kind of boogeyman they use to frighten new recruits, and children.
pft_sth_cardassian_oralian_desc: Supporters of the Oralian faith desire religious freedom and the restoration of their ancient Hebitian culture.
pft_sth_corporation_desc: A megacorporation, or mega-corporation, an extremely large and powerful company, often a conglomerate that holds significant control over multiple markets.
pft_sth_ferengi_corporation_desc: A megacorporation, or mega-corporation, an extremely large and powerful company, often a conglomerate that holds significant control over multiple markets, most having been established in the Ferengi Alliance.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_antaak_desc: A Great House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_dgor_desc: A Noble House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_duras_desc: A Great House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_gowron_desc: A Great House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_kang_desc: A Great House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_kmpec_desc: A Noble House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_koloth_desc: A Great House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_konjah_desc: A Great House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_kor_desc: A Great House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_kruge_desc: A Noble House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_ktohmaag_desc: A Noble House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_martok_desc: A Great House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_mogh_desc: A Great House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_mokai_desc: A Great House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_mowga_desc: A Noble House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_mrek_desc: A Great House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_noggra_desc: A Noble House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_palkar_desc: A Noble House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_targesh_desc: A Noble House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_tkuvma_desc: A Noble House of the Empire.
pft_sth_klingon_ho_vrag_desc: A Noble House of the Empire.
pft_sth_terran_uprising_desc: Resistance members oppose the Terran Empire's reign of terror at every opportunity.
pft_vulcan_extremists_desc: Hardline believers in Vulcan being a pure logic-driven society, free from the emotional constraints of other species.
philippa_georgiou_background: Born in the early 2200s in Pulau Langkawi, Malaysia, Earth Georgiou was no stranger to loss and battle, yet remained optimistic and true to the ideals of the Federation.
philippa_georgiou_catch_phrase: I was a Human who had seen a life of loss, but still chose hope.
phlox_background: Phlox was born sometime in the late 21st century on Denobula, in the Denobula Triaxa system becoming a physician circa 2115.
phlox_catch_phrase: If you're going to try to embrace new worlds, you must try to embrace new ideas.
picard_background: Jean-Luc Picard is a celebrated Starfleet officer, archaeologist, writer, historian, diplomat, and philanthropist, born on Earth, in France. He left the family vineyard to make his name amongst the stars.
picket_mid_range_default_behavior_desc: The ship will try to focus on intercepting charging ships and incoming fire.
planet_borg_auto_drone_transfer_desc: In keeping with Borg principles of efficiency, mega-complex drone production facilities can be configured to beam new drones directly to complexes where they are needed.
planet_food_boost_borg_desc: Utilising large amounts of nutritional resources, the Collective can increase the assembly and fitting of cybernetic components onto new drones.
planet_luxuries_boost_borg_desc: Utilising large amounts of resources, the Collective can increase its efficiency.
planetary_end_punishment_labour_camps: Release the prisoners from the Labour Camps
planetary_end_punishment_labour_camps_de: Allow the prisoners to return their homes and thank them for their services to our empire.
planetary_end_punishment_taxation_desc: The punitive tax rates will be cancelled.
planetary_punishment_labour_camps_effect: Send troublesome pops to a Labour Camp
These troublemakers should be put to hard work to remind them that causing problems for [Root.GetName] will be punished with hard work.
planetary_punishment_taxation_effects_to: Introduce a tax that increases £ Latinum by +25% but at the cost of -5 happiness. However stability rises by +20 as business owners dare not risk any more of their hard earned earnings.
plasma_storm_aftermath_custom_desc: The Plasma Storm has left dangerous levels of plasma damage across the planet.
plasma_storm_desc: A plasma storm is a type of spatial disturbance that involves energetic particles in a state called plasma.
plasma_storm_lore_description:
Nossos scanners detectaram uma tempestade cósmica do tipo $TYPE|Y$. Nós a chamamos de $NAME|Y$.

This storm will cause devastating effects to colonies and hamper our fleets' access to emergency FTL. Taking preemptive measures is strongly advised.

The extreme electrical charges carried by the storm will present a danger to our fleets' shield systems. However, we are expecting a significant increase in colony production and ship speed due to the abundant energy present in the storm.
platform_desc: This ship is a stationary defense station.
plutocracy_desc: A society ruled or controlled by a shadowy cabal of business leaders and a small minority of the wealthiest citizens of the Empire.
policy_anti_borg_1_desc: We may enact a maximum of 1 Anti-Borg Edict while this policy is in effect.
policy_anti_borg_2_desc: We may enact a maximum of 2 Anti-Borg Edicts while this policy is in effect, and the £ Influence cost of each is slightly reduced.
policy_anti_borg_3_desc: We may enact all 3 Anti-Borg Edicts while this policy is in effect, and the £ Influence cost of each is significantly reduced.
policy_anti_borg_none_desc: We will not have access to any Anti-Borg Edicts while this policy is in effect.
policy_anti_borg_policy_desc: This policy dictates our empire's investment into anti-Borg tactics and technologies. Greater investment comes at the cost of our standard research efforts.
policy_changeling_detection_policy_desc: Changeling infiltration is a threat to our way of life, but we must balance legitimate concerns against rampant paranoia.
policy_citizenship_full_desc: Allow foreigners within our border to get access to full citizenship rights.
policy_citizenship_none_desc: Restrict foreigners to limited rights only.
policy_counter_espionage_policy_desc: Espionage is an unavoidable aspect of interstellar relations. Resources can be expended to limit the effectiveness of hostile actions, but the social cost can be high.
policy_cross_breeding_policy_desc: This policy defines our empires stance on alien species cross breeding. Imposing restrictions on our population leads to a small amount of pop unhappiness.
policy_crossbreed_no_desc: Different species may not breed with each other, preventing the creation of half-species.
policy_crossbreed_yes_desc: No restrictions imposed by the government on breeding rights.
policy_de_assimilation_policy_desc: Borg drones are dangerous in isolation and deadly in groups. The approaches taken to de-assimilate drones back into individuals are limited primarily by the technology level of those performing the de-assimilation.
policy_economic_policy_desc: This policy dictates the goods and services the empire is most in need, and that will be imported at great expense from foreign sources via starports. Changing the import policy will change the output of starports across the empire.
policy_edu_accelerated_biology_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 3 £ Society Research points, each.
policy_edu_accelerated_engineering_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 3 £ Engineering Research points, each.
policy_edu_accelerated_physics_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 3 £ Physics Research points, each.
policy_edu_balanced_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 1 £ Physics Research, £ Society Research and £ Engineering Research points, each.
policy_edu_military_desc: Every £ Student will produce additional £ Trained Officers and defense armies.
policy_edu_military_name: Students produce Trained Officers and Defense Armies
policy_edu_private_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 1 £ Comércio due to a privatised education.
policy_edu_propoganda_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 1 planet stability point, each.
policy_edu_religious_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 1 £ Unity points, each.
policy_edu_social_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional +1% Recursos de £ Empregos.
policy_education_policy_desc: This policy dictates our general policy on education, and whether it is freely accessible by the general population, or not. Changing this policy setting will adjust the resource outputs of our schools and universities across the empire, but will have no impact on our dedicated laboratories and their research projects.
policy_espionage_policy_desc: Espionage is an unavoidable aspect of interstellar relations. Resources can be expended to increase the effectiveness of our efforts.
policy_espionage_policy_dominion_desc: Dominion Security, supported by the Founders is in place to ensure the security and everlasting might of the Dominion.
policy_espionage_policy_obsidian_desc: The Obsidian Order is an organisation to both respect and fear across the galaxy. Resources can be funnelled into the agency to boost their effectiveness.
policy_espionage_policy_tal_shiar_desc: The Tal Shiar is an organisation to both respect and fear across the galaxy. Resources can be funnelled into the agency to boost their effectiveness.
policy_espionage_policy_ufp_desc: Starfleet Intelligence protect Starfleets interests both internally and externally. Their effectiveness is governed by how much funding they receive.
policy_eugenics_allowed_desc: The practice of genetic modification is allowed within our empire.
policy_eugenics_outlawed_desc: The practice of genetic modification is forbidden within our borders.
policy_eugenics_policy_desc: This policy defines our stance on the medical practice of genetic modification.
policy_external_leaders_great_houses_des: Allow the Great Houses to provide external leaders
policy_external_leaders_no_desc: We may not engage and hire external leaders.
policy_external_leaders_use_policy_desc: This policy defines our usage of externally hired leaders.
policy_external_leaders_yes_desc: We may engage and hire external leaders.
policy_gender_rights_policy_desc: Gender rights refer to the state of ease of access to resources and opportunities according to gender, including economic participation and decision-making such as voting.
policy_health_clones_desc: The focus of our healthcare system is to provide every colony with a full supply of clones ready to maintain our empire. Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional +5% £ Pop Assembly Speed.
policy_health_drugs_desc: Calming pharmaceuticals are issued to most of the populace, resulting in increased stability on each planet with a £ Healthcare building.
policy_health_growth_desc: The focus of our healthcare system is to increase the welfare of our offsprings and to promote the growth of our population. Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional +5% £ Pop Growth.
policy_health_infrastructure_desc: Healthcare is focused on modernising all equipment with autonomous functions, reducing the overall burden on repair and replacement. This increases available £ Amenities by 2.
policy_health_longevity_desc: The focus of our healthcare system is to increase useable lifespan. Every £ Healthcare Job will increase our leader lifespan by 1 year.
policy_health_policy_desc: This policy dictates how our galactic medical facilities can be accessed by the general population. Changing this policy setting will change the resource outputs of our clinics and hospitals across the empire.
policy_health_private_desc: Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional 2 £ Comércio due to the privatised nature.
policy_health_social_desc: Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional 2 £ Unity.
policy_health_testing_desc: The healthcare system utilises forced testing of new medicines and drugs on patients, without their consent. Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional 10 £ Society Research at the expense of stability.
policy_health_university_desc: Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional 5 £ Society Research.
policy_import_food_desc: Our starports will focus on importing exotic food from numerous empires, increasing our total £ Food output.
policy_import_influence_desc: Our starports will focus on importing entertainment and cultural goods from other empires, increasing the cultural impact of our society and our £ Influence output.
policy_import_mineral_desc: Our starports will focus on importing rare metals and minerals, increasing our total £ Minerals output.
policy_import_prosperity_desc: Our starports will focus on importing rare luxury goods from across the galaxy, increasing the Prosperity of our people.
policy_import_research_desc: Our starports will focus on importing technologically sophisticated materials and consumer goods, allowing us insight into other avenues of technology and thus increasing our total Research output.
policy_import_unity_desc: Our starports will focus on importing long-lost religious and archaeological artifacts from across the quadrant, increasing our total £ Unity output.
policy_internal_security_policy_desc: Our internal security services work hard to prevent outside threats from harming our state.
policy_mercenary_use_no_desc: We cannot engage and hire mercenary factions.
policy_mercenary_use_policy_desc: This policy defines our usage of mercenary groups to help us in our wars.
policy_mercenary_use_yes_desc: We may engage and hire mercenary factions.
policy_orbital_bombardment_desc: Orbital Bombardment allows us to destroy armies on a planet from space. More punitive orbital bombardment stances can also destroy buildings and kill population.
policy_traffic_control_disabled_desc: Disable the automatic building of traffic control buildings.
policy_traffic_control_enabled_desc: Enable the automatic building of traffic control buildings.
policy_traffic_control_policy_desc: This Policy determines if are Starbases automatically come with a Traffic Control Facility.
policy_twoyearlyevent_policy_desc: The running of your empire's biannual espionage, trade or infiltration policy can get taxing. Decide whether you wish to see them with this toggle.
policy_ufp_crew_desc: Every member world will provide additional £ trained officers to the Federation.
policy_ufp_cultural_desc: Every member world will provide additional £ consumer goods to the Federation.
policy_ufp_economic_desc: Every member world will provide additional £ trade value to the Federation.
policy_ufp_humanitarian_desc: Every member world will increase £ unity generation in the Federation.
policy_ufp_industrial_desc: Every member world will provide additional £ alloys and £ minerals to the Federation.
policy_ufp_policy_desc: This policy dictates the United Federation of Planets policy on member worlds, and what they should focus on providing to the Federation as a whole. Changing this policy setting will adjust the resource outputs of our member worlds across the empire.
policy_ufp_tech_desc: Every member world will provide a +2.5% increase to research.
policy_ufp_war_desc: Every member world will provide additional naval capacity to the Federation.
policy_war_posture_emergency_powers_desc: Grant Emergency Powers to the governing body to handle the war time situation.
policy_war_posture_normal_desc: No stance is taking during war.
policy_war_posture_policy_desc: This Policy defines our empires stance during war time.
policy_war_posture_seek_peace_desc: We will aim to seak a peaceful resolution.
policy_war_posture_total_mobilisation_de: Full mobilisation of our war time efforts.
policy_xeno_rights_policy_desc: This policy defines how we should treat foreigners within our borders and whether they should receive full citizenship rights.
pop_cat_gorn_infant_desc: Young wild and feral, fighting for dominance and a chance to survive.
pop_cat_ketracel_white_addict_desc: Genetically Bred to be dependant on Ketracel White.
pop_cat_regeneration_desc: Pop is currently Dormant, either regenerating or hibernating.
power_map_mode_desc: Relative Fleet Power Map Mode will show you the strength of your other empires in relation to your own.
preset_annex_desc: The forcible acquisition and assertion of legal title over one state's territory by another state, usually following military occupation of the territory.
preset_annex_flavour_desc: The forcible acquisition and assertion of legal title over one state's territory by another state, usually following military occupation of the territory.
preset_dominion_member_flavor_desc: A subjugated member under the oversight of the Dominion. A member of the Dominion pays an energy and mineral tax, and also transfers any resources used in ketracel-white to the Dominion.
preset_federation_associate_desc: A Federation Associate Member has been granted limited rights of a full Federation Member world akin to that of a protectorate or vassal state of the Federation. With the goal of promoting them to full membership when the world is ready.
preset_federation_associate_flavour_desc: A Federation Associate Member has been granted limited rights of a full Federation Member world akin to that of a protectorate or vassal state of the Federation. With the goal of promoting them to full membership when the world is ready.
preset_federation_council_desc: The Federation Council is at the heart of everything the United Federation of Planets stands for. Contact the council to hold a session with the Federation Member Worlds.
preset_great_house_disloyal_flavour_desc: A Great House of the Klingon Empire that has turned its back on the High Council and renounced its alliance to the Empire.
preset_great_house_flavour_desc: The Great Houses are a Klingon feudalistic social organisation that dominate the Klingon Empire. The twenty-four most powerful Houses are represented on the Klingon High Council.
preset_member_world: United Federation of Planets Member World
preset_member_world_desc: A member of the United Federation of Planets, it largely deals with its own affairs. Depending on the Federation policy, member worlds can provide numerous bonuses as well as joining in with the prosperity of the Federation as it grows.
preset_member_world_flavour_desc: A member of the United Federation of Planets, it largely deals with its own affairs. Depending on the Federation policy, member worlds can provide numerous bonuses as well as joining in with the prosperity of the Federation as it grows.
preset_romulan_desc: Centuries of loyalty have led to this state being considered a 'close ally' of the Romulan Star Empire. Whilst technically an independant world it would take a brave leader to oppose the Star Empire.
preset_romulan_flavour_desc: Centuries of loyalty have led to this state being considered a 'close ally' of the Romulan Star Empire. Whilst technically an independant world it would take a brave leader to oppose the Star Empire.
psionic_army_2_desc: Equipados com armas que podem causar grande dano baseado puramente no sentimento do inimigo, exércitios psiônicos são quase sempre incansáveis contra adversários que não possuem mente sã.
psionic_army_desc: Soldados agraciados com habilidades psiônicas. Seu foco em poderes psiônicos destrutíveis levou à diferentes táticas e estratégias no campo de batalha. Seu primeiro objetivo é sempre remover do inimigo a vontade de lutar.
quark_background: Quark was born on Ferenginar to Keldar and Ishka; he had one younger brother, Rom.
quark_catch_phrase: Every once in a while, declare peace. It confuses the hell out of your enemies.
r_abronath_1_desc:
Collection: £Energetic Artifacts
Category: £Device Components
Origin: £Unknown
Description: The inner mechanism of the device known as the Abronath. It looks like two pieces have broken off from it, and will need to be found before it can be used.
r_abronath_2_desc:
Collection: £Energetic Artifacts
Category: £Device Components
Origin: £Unknown
Description: The central mechanism of the device known as the Abronath. It looks like two pieces have broken off from it, and will need to be found before it can be used.
r_abronath_3_desc:
Collection: £Energetic Artifacts
Category: £Device Components
Origin: £Unknown
Description: The outer mechanism of the device known as the Abronath. It looks like two pieces have broken off from it, and will need to be found before it can be used.
r_abronath_full_desc:
Collection: £Weapons and Armor
Category: £Weapons of Mass Destruction
Origin: £Altamid£Altamid£Alpha Quadrant
Description: The fully reassembled and activated Abronath, able to provide a powerful weapon to orbiting warships capable of wiping out all organic life upon a planet.
r_abronath_full_inactive_desc:
Collection: £Energetic Artifacts
Category: £Reconstructed Artifacts
Origin: £Unknown
Description: The reconstructed parts form a singular device, which currently lies dormant.
r_borg_fragment_desc:
Collection: £Space Debris
Category: £Monster Fragment
Origin: £Cube£Delta Quadrant
Description: A piece of Borg technology collected from a destroyed cube that was meant to destroy us.
r_borg_queen_trophy_desc:
Collection: £Space Debris
Category: £Monster Fragment
Origin: £Unicomplex£Delta Quadrant
Description: Scavenged from the wreckage of a Unicomplex, this skull and spine mechanism is all that remains of a Borg Queen.
r_borg_tribble_desc:
Collection: £Lifeforms
Category: £Alien Pet
Origin: £Iota Geminorum IV£Iota Geminorum£Beta Quadrant
Description: Not every assimilated creature brings the Collective closer to perfection. This is preserved for research purposes.
r_borg_trophy: Perhaps Resistance is not so futile
r_borg_trophy_desc:
Collection: £Space Debris
Category: £Monster Fragment
Origin: The Borg Cube£Delta Quadrant
Description: A piece of Borg technology collected from a defeated drone.
r_cardassian_trophy_desc:
Collection: £Space Debris
Category: £Monster Fragment
Origin: £Cardassia Prime£Alpha Quadrant
Description: A gentle reminder to the Cardassian people who who is truly superior.
r_colAndor_scrolls_desc:
Collection: £Written Works
Category: £Governing Documents
Origin: £Andoria£Procyon£Beta Quadrant
Description: The ColAndor Scrolls are a revered Andorian artefact that has served as inspiration and guidance for the formation of governments. They were displayed as part of a cultural exhibition for the Tellarites, to demonstrate how they could establish their own government, but were stolen.
r_dilithium_incubator_desc:
Collection: £Energetic Artifacts
Category: £Warp Engine Components
Origin: £Xahea£Xahea£Beta Quadrant
Description: An experimental device created by the Xaheans, the dilithium incubator is able to repair and recrystallise fractured dilithium crystals.
r_doomsday_machine_fragment_desc:
Collection: £Space Debris
Category: £Monster Fragment
Origin: £Extragalactic
Description: A chunk of solid Neutronium, gathered from the wreckage of the Doomsday Machine.
r_echo_papa_drone_desc:
Collection: £Weapons and Armor
Category: £Drones
Origin: £Minos£Lorenze Cluster
Description: The remnants of a powerful Echo Papa drone stand as a reminder of the 'arsenal of freedom'.
r_enigma_tales_desc:
Collection: £Written Works
Category: £Popular Literature
Origin: £Cardassia£Cardassia£Alpha Quadrant
Description: Written by Shoggoth, the novel covers numerous suspects, all being found guilty of similar crime with the mystery lying in the discovery of who exactly was guilty of what.
r_ferengi_trophy: A prize worth more than Latinum
r_ferengi_trophy_desc:
Collection: £Energetic Artifacts
Category: £War Trophy
Origin: £Ferenginar£Ferenginar£Alpha Quadrant
Description: Some prizes are worth more than Gold Pressed Latinum and a reminder of our superiority is worth a thousand bricks.
r_first_contact_memento: A memento from humanity's First Contact
r_first_contact_memento_desc:
Collection: £Starships
Category: £Historical Vessels
Origin: £Earth£Sol£Alpha Quadrant
Description: A memento taken from the actual first contact between Earth and Vulcan.
r_gboj_torch_desc:
Collection: £Weapons and Armor
Category: £Melee Weapons
Origin: £Qo'noS£Qo'noS£Beta Quadrant
Description: The Torch of G'boj was lit in the fires of Mount Do'om and used to pierce the heart of Har'el the foul. Even now, the saying 'as bright as the Torch of G'boj' is still used to describe something dazzling.
r_gomtuu_desc:
Collection: £Space Debris
Category: £Monster Fragment
Origin: £Extragalactic
Description: Dissected hull of the space creature Gomtuu.
r_hand_of_kull_desc:
Collection: £Weapons and Armor
Category: £Melee Weapons
Origin: £Qo'noS£Qo'noS£Beta Quadrant
Description: The Hand of Kull is a Klingon hand-held weapon, once wielded by the legendary warrior Kull. During the battle against Kinaan the Foul, Kull lost his left hand when slaying the tyrant.
r_hologram_bottle_desc:
Collection: £Cultural Artifacts
Category: £Holograms
Origin: £Earth£Sol£Alpha Quadrant
Description: An entire holographic universe designed as a containment device for Moriarty, a genius level rogue hologram.
r_horgahn_desc:
Collection: £Cultural Artifacts
Category: £Carvings
Origin: £Risa£Epsilon Ceti£Alpha Quadrant
Description: A Horga'hn is a statuette that served as a fertility symbol on Risa. It is believed that to own one was to call forth its powers. Displaying one publicly indicates that one is seeking jamaharon, a mysterious and pleasurable practice native to that world.
r_kcabadge_desc:
Collection: £Heraldry
Category: £Personal Insignia
Origin: £Mirror Universe
Description: This combadge is all that remains of the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance invasion from a breach between dimensions.
r_kir_shara_desc:
Collection: £Religious Artifacts
Category: £Psionic Artifacts
Origin: £Vulcan£40 Eridani£Alpha Quadrant
Description: The Kir'Shara is an ancient Vulcan artifact containing the writings of Surak.
r_klingon_trophy: A trophy from defeating the Klingons
r_klingon_trophy_desc:
Collection: £Starships
Category: £War Trophy
Origin: £Qo'noS£Qo'noS£Beta Quadrant
Description: A memento taken from the battlefield, when Earth defeated the Klingon Empire.
r_ktarian_game_desc:
Collection: £Cultural Artifacts
Category: £Electronic Entertainment
Origin: £Ktaria£Ktaria£Alpha Quadrant
Description: An addictive single player game from the planet Ktaria.
r_masaka_mask_desc:
Collection: £Religious Artifacts
Category: £Psionic Artifacts
Origin: £Archive£D'Arsay£Sector 1156
Description: This mask serves as a memento of the experience with the D'Arsay archive.
r_meditations_on_a_crimson_shadow_desc:
Collection: £Written Works
Category: £Popular Literature
Origin: £Cardassia£Cardassia£Alpha Quadrant
Description: Set in the near future as the Cardassian Union fights against the evil empires of the galaxy.
r_metaphasic_collector_desc:
Collection: £Starships
Category: £Support Vessels
Origin: £Ba'ku£Briar Patch£Alpha Quadrant
Description: With the Ba'ku system under the control of the [Root.GetName], technology has been developed to harvest the metaphasic radiation within the rings, entailing the use of a piece of equipment known as an injector assembly to be launched from the Collector right into the rings of Ba'ku. There it will start a thermolytic reaction, the radiation of which to be collected by the collector.
r_ncia93_desc: A heavily encrypted data core from a captured Section 31 vessel. Teams continually work on breaking it's ever adapting codes.
r_never_ending_sacrifice_desc:
Collection: £Written Works
Category: £Popular Literature
Origin: £Cardassia£Cardassia£Alpha Quadrant

r_rules_of_acquisition_desc:
