em_colAndor_desc: The colAndor Scrolls are a revered Andorian artifact which serves as an inspiration on how one was to form a government.
em_colAndor_scrolls_desc: The colAndor Scrolls are a revered Andorian artifact which serves as an inspiration on how one was to form a government.
em_colAndor_scrolls_lost_desc: The shame of losing the colAndor scrolls disheartens many.
em_concerning_events_desc: Strange activity near our home worlds star is a cause for concern.
em_confederacy_of_surak_desc: The Confederacy of Surak is the formal name for the Vulcan government, dedicated to embracing more of Surak's ideals.
em_construction_and_desc: Focus on high-powered weaponry comes to the detriment of hull strength and shield strength with Andorian vessels.
em_construction_bre_desc: Breen construction methods favor heavy weaponry over hull strength. Their shielding is considered on par with most other space empires.
em_construction_brg_desc: Borg vessels conform to simple geometric shapes, allowing for numerous cells interlinked within cells interlinked within one shape for maximum redundancy. Their massive size results in vessels that are costly to produce, but has improved energy for weapons which allows them to punch through shields and armour.
em_construction_car_desc: Sturdy hulls protect Cardassian vessels from harm, with a lower emphasis on shielding and weaponry. This does tend to reduce the cost of construction slightly.
em_construction_dom_desc: Strong vessels with the latest weaponry are the method of choice for ship construction amongst the Dominion.
em_construction_fed_desc: Humanity's distinct starship construction method emphasizes separation of the main from the secondary hull. The result is an expensive, yet surprisingly sturdy design.
em_construction_fer_desc: Rule of Acquisition 261 - 'A wealthy man can afford everything except a conscience'. This philosophy extends to Ferengi starship design too, with expensive shielding available, though lowest bidding manufacturers tend to reduce the quality of the hull.
em_construction_hus_desc: Husnock construction embodies patience and overwhelming superiority. Very strong weaponry comes at the cost of survivability and high production costs, but sacrifice fulfils the goals of the Ascendancy.
em_construction_kaz_desc: Kazon ships designs provoke one word to mind - expendable. They are cheap to mass produce with strong weaponry but their shielding and hulls cannot stand up to the same punishment as other races.
em_construction_kdf_desc: Klingon vessels favour aggression and weaponry, resulting in vessels that have increased damage, but cheaper, less sturdy hulls.
em_construction_kob_desc: Crewed by resurrected bodies with little fear of death and warfare, the Kobali vessels are cheaper to build than many other races, but their weapons are of a lower power.
em_construction_ori_desc: Orion vessels are often decorated in ornate gilding and decorative objects that belie their true purpose - that of a vicious and nimble predator.
em_construction_rom_desc: Romulan vessels take their design philosophy from graceful birds of prey of the Star Empire. This results in hulls less sturdy than those of other races, but the advanced power generation allows for increased shielding.
em_construction_she_desc: The Corporate has a keen edge towards precision for designs of their ships, and a ruthless procurements department. This focus on having a source of modular interchangeable parts reduces the building cost of their vessels.
em_construction_sul_desc: Suliban ship designs are modular in design, and can often interlock with other vessels easily. This results in a construction that is slightly weaker than other hulls, but makes up this weakness with stronger shields and easily replaceable parts reducing the cost.
em_construction_tel_desc: Tellarite vessels are - like their people - designed to be stubborn. The argumentative nature of Tellarites results in a lower cost vessel than other races.
em_construction_tho_desc: Crystalline in design and formed by the rigors of Class Y planets which Tholians call home, Tholian vessels are mainly heavily shielded ships that are designed to operate in groups utilising heavy weaponry.
em_construction_vid_desc: Crewed by members infected with the Phage, Vidiian ships focus on ending engagements quickly. Their unique thermal lance technology allows for improved shield penetration.
em_construction_vot_desc: Voth vessels utilise advanced technology to promote their edge, and their mastery of ship construction over millennia has led to extremely durable vessels with powerful shields.
em_construction_vul_desc: It is only logical to ensure that additional construction materials should be used to ensure our vessels and crews are equipped with superior shielding and weaponry. Vulcan ships tend to follow a standard design with large warp generating coleopteric rings to propel them through space.
em_construction_xin_desc: Xindi vessels are unique for each subspecies of the Xindi. This design philosophy to focus on one race's needs reduces the cost required to build a vessel, however it also results in a weaker hull than most.
em_country_divided_desc: Our people are in turmoil, their faith in the government diminished.
em_country_united_desc: Our people are fully united behind the government.
em_crystalline_jewel_active_effect_desc: Run scientific experiments on the crystalline jewel.
em_darsay_korgano_desc: Korgano, God of the Moon is now in ascendancy. Under his cool light reason prevails, and the people enjoy lasting prosperity.
em_darsay_masaka_desc: Masaka, the Goddess of the Sun, is now ascendancy. Her blazing light warms the blood in the heart of every soldier, calling them to war.
em_demilitarisation_desc: Forceful demilitarisation reduces the size of our fleets substantially.
em_disrupted_ship_comms_desc: All intership communications and coordination has been cut.
em_doctor_sf_medical_desc: Starfleet medical has gained one of the very best doctors in the fleet.

The result is an overall increase in the Dominion naval support. This is the maximum benefit we can gain from Dominion members.

em_echo_papa_space_desc: Reactivating the Echo Papa drones to act as a deterrent within our space increases the fire rate of any fleets within our territory for a short time.

em_order_of_basai: The Order of Basai is the name given to the master poets and storytellers amongst the Klingon people. Their passion and gift for telling tales of glory affords them great respect from fellow Klingons.
em_order_of_basai_desc: An elite cartel of Klingon storytellers an master poets regailing the empire with tales of honour and glory.
em_order_of_the_batleth: The Order of the Bat'leth is an exclusive Klingon group, a status awarded to warriors who had distinguished themselves in battle. Their battlehardened veterans serve the Empire loyally.
em_order_of_the_batleth_desc: The Yan-Isleth, or Brotherhood of the Sword, are an elite Klingon division who will protect the Klingon chancellor with their lives.

em_suspicious_contact_desc: We have discovered a new empire that has put us on our guard.
em_sword_of_kahless_dividing_desc: Our people are in turmoil with the return of the Sword. All covet it and few trust the one who wields it...
em_sword_of_kahless_unifying_desc: Our people are overjoyed to see the Sword returned to its rightful place on the homeworld.
em_synthetic_research_ban_desc: The leadership has placed a ban on all future usage and research into synthetic technologies.
em_syrrannite_protests_desc: Oppression of the Syrrannite minority has caused a great deal of strife within Vulcan society.
em_talshiar_presence_desc: The Tal Shiar heavily control activities on this planet. The populace live in fear and nothing gets past their watchful presence.
em_terra_prime_desc: Hidden supply caches supply Terra Prime with many excess resources.
em_the_art_of_the_bribe_desc: Trunt's 'The Art of the Bribe' is amusing our people as an effective guide on how to not make Latinum.
em_the_dream_of_the_fire_desc: Our people are inspired by K'Ratak's epic novel 'qul naj'.
em_the_never_ending_sacrifice_desc: Our people are inspired by Ulan Corac's novel The Never Ending Sacrifice.
em_the_wait_desc: Our people are inspired by the visceral writing in Revalus' The Wait.
em_time_crystal_instability_desc: Actions with the Time Crystal Device which failed to defeat threats to the leadership have decreased stability.
em_time_crystal_stability_desc: Actions with the Time Crystal Device to defeat threats to the leadership have improved stability.
em_torch_of_gboj: We claim the Torch of G'Boj! The Torch illuminates the darkness whence all other lights go out.
em_torch_of_gboj_desc: We claim the Torch of G'Boj! The Torch illuminates the darkness whence all other lights go out.
em_tox_uthat_desc: The power of the Tox Uthat is improving the weaponry onboard our vessels.
em_trade_embargo_desc: The embargo upon our worlds results in a substantial malus to production of all energy, food and minerals.
em_ufp_member_morale_neg_boost: Bad spirits across UFP Member Worlds
em_ufp_member_morale_neg_boost_desc: Recent activities in the UFP council meetings have created a feelings of hostility amongst many member worlds.
em_ufp_member_morale_pos_boost: Good spirit across the UFP Member Worlds
em_ufp_member_morale_pos_boost_desc: Recent activities in the UFP council meetings have created a feeling of unity across the member worlds.
em_ufp_peace_bonus_desc: Federation Defensive War Effort sanctioned by the Federation Council.
em_ufp_war_bonus_desc: Federation Offensive War Effort sanctioned by the Federation Council.
em_ufp_war_morale_neg_boost_desc: The recent critism of the war by members of the Federation council has had a negative impact on our crews.
em_ufp_war_morale_pos_boost_desc: The recent backing of the war by even its staunchest opponents has given our crews a well need boost.
em_undine_advantage_desc: A deadly weapon against the Undine developed in the Delta Quadrant.
em_undine_invasion_force_desc: The Undine Vanguard are on the rampage and ready for war.
em_undine_weapon_desc: Inspired by Borg Nano-probes to attack the Undine at a cellular level.
em_unhappy_abandoned_crew_desc: The crew of one of our vessels was left abandoned behind enemy lines.
em_unhappy_taxes_desc: Free enterprise chafes under the oppressive yolk of taxation. Businessmen everywhere suffer.
em_very_concerning_events_desc: Very strange activity near our home worlds star is a cause for concern, with some scientists believing the star is collapsing.
em_vorta_governor_desc: An attache from the Dominion has arrived to provide governance and leadership to our people.
em_vorta_governor_human_desc: An attache from the Dominion has arrived to provide governance and leadership to our people.
em_vorta_scientist_desc: An attache from the Dominion has arrived to provide governance and leadership to our people.
em_vorta_scientist_human_desc: An attache from the Dominion has arrived to provide governance and leadership to our people.
em_we_civil_disruption_desc: Supply shortages, protests, and internal disruption are spreading as the war drags on.
em_we_legitimacy_crisis_desc: The government's legitimacy is collapsing under the strain of total war.
em_we_political_strain_desc: War exhaustion is pushing public confidence and institutions to the limit.
em_weapon_testing_desc: We are utilising a planetoid for weapon testing, improving our research in that area.
em_xindi_council_aquatic_desc: Xindi-Aquatic leadership is focused on physics research at the expense of material production.
em_xindi_council_arboreal_desc: Xindi-Arboreal leadership is focused on engineering research at the expense of energy production.
em_xindi_council_avian_desc: Xindi-Avian leadership is focused on uniting all Xindi behind a common cause.
em_xindi_council_insectoid_desc: Xindi-Insectoid leadership is focused on pushing Xindi unity at the expense of scientific development.
em_xindi_council_primate_desc: Xindi-Primate leadership is focused on social research at the expense of expansion.
em_xindi_council_reptilian_desc: Xindi-Reptilian leadership is focused on expansion at the expense of scientific development.
em_yan_isleth: The Yan-Isleth, or Brotherhood of the Sword, are an elite Klingon division who will protect the Klingon chancellor with their lives.
em_yan_isleth_desc: The Yan-Isleth, or Brotherhood of the Sword, are an elite Klingon division who will protect the Klingon chancellor with their lives.
em_zhat_vash_desc: The Zhat Vash are active working in the shadows.
embassy_colony_desc: This world is a dedicated embassy world
embassy_colony_other_planets_desc: We have an Embassy world within our empire.
es_spynetwork_counter_intel_1_desc: The higher our encryption the better our counter-intel will be.
es_spynetwork_counter_intel_2_desc: The higher our encryption the better our counter-intel will be.
es_spynetwork_counter_intel_3_desc: Counter Intelligence is made more difficult by our lower encryption levels.

es_spynetwork_counter_intel_asset_desc: Our target has compromised one of our assets, making operations against them more difficult.
es_spynetwork_counter_intel_feed_1_desc: We believe our informant may have been compromised ad the information provided unreliable.
es_spynetwork_counter_intel_feed_2_desc: We believe our informant may have been compromised ad the information provided unreliable.
es_spynetwork_counter_intel_leak_desc: A security leak has compromised our security.
es_spynetwork_counter_intel_leak_fixed_d: Our agents are fixing a security leak, diverting resources from other counterintelligence activities.
es_spynetwork_counter_intel_leak_good_de: Our agents are using a security leak as a trap to detect foreign operatives.
es_spynetwork_counter_intel_security_1_d: Our target has arrested some of our operatives, forcing our remaining agents into hiding.
es_spynetwork_counter_intel_security_2_d: Our target has arrested some of our operatives, forcing our remaining agents to lay low.
es_spynetwork_counter_intel_suspicious_d: Foreign agents are trying to cover up their presence.
es_spynetwork_expel_syndicate_desc: Expelling criminal branch offices is difficult.
fl_changeling_fleet_discoordination_desc: A changeling infiltrator amongst our fleet has caused havoc!
fl_fleet_mothballed_desc: All great careers come to an end, and the same is true of Starships.
fl_fleet_reactivated_desc: Fleet has recently been reactivated and is still undergoing system upgrades while operating with a skeleton crew.
fl_undine_fleet_discoordination_desc: An Undine infiltrator amongst our fleet has caused havoc!
fluidic_bio_world_desc: Unique to Fluidic space, this world is closer to being a living being than a planet.
fluidic_infestation_desc: This planet is being infested by the Undine.
forge_colony_desc: This entire world is industrialised and dedicated to production.
forge_colony_other_planets_desc: We have a Forge colony within our empire.
fortress_colony_desc: This world is a dedicated fortress world
fortress_colony_other_planets_desc: We have a Fortress world within our empire.
frequent_earthquakes_desc: Constant activity in the bowels of the planet, leads to very frequent earthquakes. In addition to the difficult living conditions, the erection of structures on this planet will require additional funds.
gatherer_attack_desc: Gatherers have recently attacked this world, leaving devastation behind
giant_waves_desc: This planet is under the constant influence of the gravity of neighboring celestial bodies, which leads to the emergence of giant waves reaching several kilometres in height, these waves crashing down the giant tsunami on the coast and shaking the depths of the oceans.
glowing_ocean_desc: The oceans of this planet are filled with various forms of life, while the flora and fauna show a very active luminescence.The abundant glow of all forms of life is noticeable even from outer space, and landscapes on the surface abound with riotous colors. Unfortunately, the prospects of this planet are not so rosy, since the constant glow of organisms, makes them literally suck energy from any surrounding sources.
heavy_blizzards_desc: Almost unceasing snowstorms on this planet disrupt signals and make communication difficult, which is why the settlements on this planet will be periodically cut off from each other.
heavy_sandstorms_desc: Huge and violent sandstorms take the scant soil of this planet into the atmosphere and spread for many kilometres. Surviving in this world is not easy, but the natural filtration of the rock provides good opportunities for mining.
honour_restored_desc: We have restored our honour in glorious combat.
hot_arid_world_desc: A Minshara class world. The Arid-type class M planet is a dry, rocky world. The dust-covered terrain consists largely of mesas and canyons. Forests can be found in the more temperate polar regions, but vegetation is otherwise scarce.
hot_assimilated_world_desc: This world would naturally have a warm climate, but has been infected with Borg nanites which have terraformed the world.
hot_desert_island_world_desc: The few land masses above the surface of the water are dry, desolate deserts with little vegetation.
hot_dune_world_desc: Very little water exists on this world, which is made up almost entirely of windswept sand dunes created by the constantly blustery conditions across the surface.
hot_med_world_desc: The mediterranean environment of this world offers a very pleasant climate with warm, dry summers and cool, mild winters.
hot_mesa_world_desc: Elevated mesas rising from the desert surface of the world offer some respite from the temperatures below, albeit at the disadvantage of being in direct sunlight.
hot_oasis_world_desc: Extremely high temperatures across most of the desert terrain are interspersed with large oases filled with water, offering sanctuaries of vegetation.
hot_savannah_world_desc: A Minshara class world. The Savannah-type class M planet has a rocky surface dominated by dry, arid plains. The small hydrosphere allows for brief wet seasons, but aside from a few ubiquitous grasses, vegetation is largely concentrated around shallow oases.
hunting_colony_desc: This world is a dedicated hunting world
iconia_desc: Devastated by an orbital bombardment over 20,000 years ago, this world was said to be the homeworld of the extinct Iconian civilisation.
incessant_thunderstorm_desc: Due to the uneven heating caused by unstable solar activity, the atmosphere of this planet is in constant motion and is accompanied by violent storms with abundant lightning discharges.
investigation_doubt_desc: With the radical new origin theory spreading in the scientific circles many have started to question their traditional believes, leading to emotional turmoil and reduced happiness.
janus_colony_desc: A geologically stable world, with no seismic activity of any sort, which makes it ideally for deep tunnel mining. Rich mineral deposits under the ground are difficult to reach but their abundance makes mining attractive. Rumours of a devil in the dark are just that, rumours.
kaminar_watchfuleye_desc: The Watchful Eye watches over Kaminar.
karstic_planet_desc: This planet was once an oceanic world, but as a result of changes in star activity, the oceans boiled and evaporated, exposing the surface covered with deep scars and caverns. The entire planet is covered with giant gorges and a huge network of caves now of value only for pirate and terrorist groups.
long_night_desc: The eclipses of the sun on this planet, caused by neighboring heavenly bodies, lead to a very long night, which can last several months.
luna_colony_desc: Small Colonies spread out across bio-bubbles along the surface of the Moon.
mars_colony_2_desc: It is now possible to walk around on the surface of Mars without the need of a spacesuit, but there is still much to do.
mars_colony_3_desc: Water, fields and forest spread across blue Mars. It is not Earth, but it isn't that far, either.
mars_colony_desc: Untamed, raw Mars still has many facilities that reach back to the early 21st century, making life on the red planet at least bearable.
meteorite_showers_desc: The atmosphere of this planet can contain deadly meteorite streams, because of which the surface is constantly subjected to massive bombardment.
military_action_concern_desc: Following the recent unsuccessful military intervention, the population is rightly concerned about our military.
miniature_population_desc: A sizable population of miniature beings, rendered smaller by a strange physical process on a distant world, is present on this planet.

monstrous_avalanches_desc: The incredibly high peaks of this planet collect on their slopes most of the precipitation, which then collapse rattling avalanches into the nearby plains.
mountainous_world_desc: As a result of the rapid movement of the lithospheric plates, the planet is almost completely covered by a continuous network of mountain ranges. The almost complete absence of flat surfaces will lead to additional costs for infrastructure development, but there are advantages in everything: rich mineral deposits are located almost at the surface itself.

pjem_colony_desc: P'Jem is a lush jungle like world, which has been used by the Vulcans for centuries as a religious retreat.
pl_charismatic_fathers_bad: Charismatic Fathers of Profit and Loss
pl_charismatic_fathers_bad_desc: A recent pilgrimage by the Charismatic Fathers of Profit and Loss has failed to stir local entrepreneurial attitudes.
pl_charismatic_fathers_good: Charismatic Fathers of Profit and Loss
pl_charismatic_fathers_good_desc: A recent pilgrimage by the Charismatic Fathers of Profit and Loss has succeeded in stirring local entrepreneurial attitudes.
pl_diplomacy_module_desc: Orbiting diplomatic facilities allow for an improvement in the trust between our two races.
pl_gambling_module_desc: Bright lights and hedonistic charm ensure that the rich and famous come up to our orbital casino to spend their hard earn credits.
pl_medical_module_desc: Medical experts from an orbiting science vessel are assisting this planet with advanced medical procedures and treatments.
pl_neglected_desc: Central government has neglected the needs of this colony.
pl_pjem_sensor_desc: Hidden under a mundane ruin, this covert subspace listening post records and documents everything within its radius.
pl_prison_module_desc: An orbiting prison facility on a nearby science vessel houses the most dangerous and twisted of criminals.
pl_religious_module_desc: Religious leaders from an orbiting science vessel ensure this planet follows the true way.
planet_artifact_showcase_desc: Artifacts found across the galaxy are being showcased here for all.
planet_artifact_trading_time_crystal_des: Minor artifacts are being traded on the open market for rare time crystals.
planet_consumer_goods_1_desc: Planet is actively engaged in a resupply operation boosting the consumer goods production.
planet_consumer_goods_2_desc: This planet has recently been restocked and the amount of consumer goods produced is thriving.
planet_diplomacy_bonus_1_desc: The full diplomatic and management functions of the nearby starship are boosting the governance of this planet.
planet_diplomacy_bonus_2_desc: The governance and diplomatic services on this world have received a welcome boost.
planet_flagship_bonus_1_desc: The flagship of the fleet is paying this planet an official visit, resulting in a boost for the planet.
planet_flagship_bonus_2_desc: The planet is basking in the excitement of a visit from the fleet's Flagship.
planet_medical_supplies_1_desc: This planet is actively being supported by a medical team.
planet_medical_supplies_2_desc: This planet has recently been supported by a medical operation and is fully stocked with medical supplies.
planet_museum_exhibits_auction_desc: Artifacts found around the galaxy are being auction here for profit.
planet_museum_exhibits_culture_desc: Cultural artifacts found around the galaxy are exhibited in museums here.
planet_museum_exhibits_entertainment_des: Artifacts found around the galaxy are exhibited here, for entertainment purposes.
planet_science_supplies_1_desc: This planet has recently been supported by a science team boosting scientific endeavours across the planet.
planet_science_supplies_2_desc: Scientific research across the planet is thriving as a result of the recent mission.
planet_security_bonus_1_desc: The planetary security forces are being bolstered by marines from the ships in orbit.
planet_security_bonus_2_desc: Security forces on this planet have been reinforced by the ships in orbit.
planet_security_bonus_3_desc: Special Security forces on this planet have been reinforced by the ships in orbit.
planet_supply_run_1_desc: An orbitting ship is currently providing much-requested cargo to the facilties on the planet below.
planet_supply_run_2_desc: A recent supply run has boosted the planet economy.
planetary_punishment_curfew_desc: A curfew has been initiated as punishment for this planets behaviour.
planetary_punishment_disease_desc: The owners of this planet have inflected a deadly but non contagious disease on the population of this planet for offenses committed.
planetary_punishment_executions_desc: This population has been punished by having a number of prominent radicals executed publicly.
planetary_punishment_labour_camps_desc: Labour camps have been opened across the planet as a punishment for recent behaviour.
planetary_punishment_taxation_desc: For offenses against this planets owner heavy fines and taxes are now in place.
plebeian_discontent_desc: Recent rumors about the existence of the Fifth Scroll have caused a considerable amount of resentment in the lower classes.
pm_archaeological_event_desc: There has been a major site found on this world and the scientific community is flocking to the planet to join the investigation.
pm_armstrong_city_desc: Named for the first human to set foot on the moon, Armstrong City has become a major settlement on Luna.
pm_atmospheric_converter_desc: The installation of an Atmospheric Converter aids in the terraforming of a world with little chance of supporting any form of life.
pm_atmospheric_processor_desc: The installation of an Atmospheric Processor provides a much-needed boost to the Terraforming process.
pm_atmospheric_shield_desc: Planet requires an Atmospheric Shield to protect the population from the effects of long term climate disruption.
pm_bajoran_emissary_desc: The Bajoran People have found their Emissary who will guide them on the path of the Prophets.
pm_bajoran_resistance_cells_desc: The Bajoran people are quick to resist foreign oppression.
pm_bajoran_resistance_cells_large_desc: The Bajoran people are quick to resist foreign oppression.
pm_borg_unicomplex_expansion_1_desc: The Collective has expanded this section of the unicomplex to allow 3 more districts to be built.
pm_borg_unicomplex_expansion_2_desc: The Collective has expanded this section of the unicomplex to allow 6 more districts to be built.
pm_borg_unicomplex_expansion_3_desc: The Collective has expanded this section of the unicomplex to allow 9 more districts to be built.
pm_city_ship_desc: Ancient, massive, built using forgotten techniques and technologies, the City Ship is a veritable fortress, housing many millions of Voth.
pm_cold_antartic_world_desc: Far colder and less hospitable even than arctic-M planets, class-P planets do not have the nickel-iron core of Minshara worlds. Over 80% of the surface is frozen water, glaciers that are millions of years old and miles of frozen ice. This world rarely experiences temperatures higher than -30° Celsius.
pm_cold_geothermal_world_desc: Somewhat more frequent than their Q-variable brothers, Q-geothermal class planets also have an incredibly varied collection of biomes. Q-geothermal are often C or P class planets that still have a highly active core, and their thermal vents melt glaciers and allow for local pockets of heat and life to flourish.
pm_cold_high_desert_world_desc: With no precipitation to speak of, areas of this world have not seen snow fall on its frozen grounds in centuries making it one of the dryest planets that has an abundance of water. Permafrost covers most of the surface.
pm_cold_snow_world_desc: Far colder and less hospitable even than arctic-M planets, class-P planets do not have the nickel-iron core of Minshara worlds. Over 50% of the surface is frozen water, with snow falling constantly for millions of years. This world rarely experiences temperatures higher than -0° Celsius, but also rarely experiences temperatures below -20°C.
pm_cold_subarctic_world_desc: Far colder and less hospitable even than arctic-M planets, class-P planets do not have the nickel-iron core of Minshara worlds. Over 80% of the surface is frozen water, glaciers that are millions of years old and miles of frozen ice. This world rarely experiences temperatures higher than 0° Celsius.
pm_cold_tundra_world_desc: Tree growth is hindered by low temperatures and short growing seasons, leaving just dwarf shrubs, sedges and grasses, mosses, and lichens available for cultivation.
pm_crime_wave_cleared_desc: Our security forces have recently cleared a major criminal faction from this planet.
pm_defenses_surveyed_desc: Our enemy has surveyed our defenses, and now knows our weaknesses.
pm_demilitarized_planet_desc: This planet has been banned from hosting any military or offensive facilities.
pm_dummy_assembly: You should not see this. Contact the Q.
pm_dummy_assembly_desc: You should not see this. Contact the Q.
pm_federation_aid_desc: The UFP has provided assistance to this world to help it through a crisis.
pm_fluidic_conversion_desc: This planet is being converted into a Bioworld by the Undine.
pm_gallitep_desc: Gallitep is a forced labor camp on the planet Bajor that was run by the Cardassians during the Cardassian Occupation of Bajor. Conditions in the camp are considered to be brutal and hostile.
pm_genesis_planet_desc: Created by the powerful effect of the Genesis Wave, this planet is a marvel of science and a perfect haven for life.
pm_havesting_occupied_world_2_desc: This planet is significantly benefitting from the natural resources of another planet.
pm_havesting_occupied_world_desc: This planet is benefitting from the natural resources of another planet.
pm_hot_arid_world_desc: A Minshara class world. The Arid-type class M planet is a dry, rocky world. The dust-covered terrain consists largely of mesas and canyons. Forests can be found in the more temperate polar regions, but vegetation is otherwise scarce.
pm_hot_desert_island_world_desc: The few land masses above the surface of the water are dry, desolate deserts with little vegetation.
pm_hot_dune_world_desc: Very little water exists on this world, which is made up almost entirely of windswept sand dunes created by the constantly blustery conditions across the surface.
pm_hot_med_world_desc: The mediterranean environment of this world offers a very pleasant climate with warm, dry summers and cool, mild winters.
pm_hot_mesa_world_desc: Elevated mesas rising from the desert surface of the world offer some respite from the temperatures below, albeit at the disadvantage of being in direct sunlight.
pm_hot_oasis_world_desc: Extremely high temperatures across most of the desert terrain are interspersed with large oases filled with water, offering sanctuaries of vegetation.
pm_hot_savannah_world_desc: A Minshara class world. The Savannah-type class M planet has a rocky surface dominated by dry, arid plains. The small hydrosphere allows for brief wet seasons, but aside from a few ubiquitous grasses, vegetation is largely concentrated around shallow oases.
pm_housing_our_enemy_desc: Our government has decided to allow our mortal enemy to settle on this world causing fear and concern amongst the local pop.
pm_humpback_whales_desc: A population of humpback whales exists on this planet, singing their whale song across the oceans.
pm_intermittent_power_drains_desc: An unknown phenomenon is causing seismic shocks and frequent interruptions to this planet's power supply.
pm_jammed_subspace_comms_desc: Renegades have managed to disrupt the planetary communications net.
pm_labour_camps_desc: A labor camp or work camp is a detention facility where inmates are forced to engage in penal labor as a form of punishment.
pm_luna_armstrong_city_desc: Named for the first human to set foot on the moon, Armstrong City has become a major settlement on Luna.
pm_luna_new_berlin_desc: Large enough to be seen from Earth in the daytime, this Luna Colony is one of the major cities on Earth's moon.
pm_luna_tycho_city_desc: One of several lunar landmarks large enough to be seen from Earth in the daytime.
pm_major_holo_concern_desc: Our organic population are showing signs of major concern over recent events in the news surrounding holographic activity.
pm_militarists_rising:
Militarism is growing on this world, and citizens shun our governance. 
Governing Attraction: -30%
pm_military_presence_desc: The government has opted to send in a military force to keep the peace, by any means.
pm_minor_holo_concern_desc: Our organic population are uneasy over recent events in the news surrounding holographic activity.
pm_museum_ship_in_orbit_desc: A museum ship orbits this planet, entertaining and providing a historical site.
pm_nearby_waste_desc: Toxic waste pollutes vast swathes of this world.
pm_new_berlin_desc: Large enough to be seen from Earth in the daytime, this Luna Colony is one of the major cities on Earth's moon.
pm_new_frontier_desc: Newly colonised world, a new frontier to call home.
pm_new_world_desc: Newly aquired world, a new frontier move to.
pm_occupation_unease_desc: The population are growing uneasy at our new overlords, are they as benevolent as they seemed to be?
pm_planet_attacked_desc: Ths planet has recently suffered a horrific attack, leaving scars which will take time to heal.
pm_planet_on_fire_desc: The recent attack against this planet have left the skies on fire causing massive destruction.
pm_planet_riots_desc: The population is openly rioting against conditions on their planet.
pm_planetary_celebration_desc: This world is undergoing a planet-wide celebration.
pm_pollen_hallucinogen_desc: Pollen with psychotropic properties is heavily present in the atmosphere of this world. Significant effort must be made to counter its effects.
pm_praxis_debris_desc: The moon Praxis has exploded and with it comes a rain of debris on Qo'nos. Our productivity is severely impaired by this.
pm_recent_disease_desc: A major disease hit this planet recently leaving lasting effects on the planet and its population.
pm_remans_citizens_desc: The population of Romulus has been provoked into anger at the decision to grant the population of their sister world the same freedoms as they receive.
pm_remans_free_desc: Years of oppression has ended and the Remans celebrate their new found status as equals.
pm_remans_slave_desc: The Reman's chafe at the brutal treatment they receive at the hands of their Romulan oppressors.
pm_rooting_out_criminals_desc: Increased Police Presence taking drastic measures to root out foreign criminals.
pm_security_operation_desc: The levels of crime on this planet require a special operation by the governments security and police forces.
pm_starship_crash_site_desc: The crash site and final resting place of one of our starships.
pm_starvation_desc: This planet is suffering from Starvation, causing the population to suffer.

pm_tarakis_monument_hidden_desc: Many who venture near this world report vivid and disruptive nightmares.
pm_terrans_free_desc: The Terrans have gained their freedom and celebrate it.
pm_titan_training_desc: Home of the imfamous Omega training missions, one of the toughest training locations in sol.
pm_tribble_take_over_1_desc: A colony of wild tribbles has been found on this planet. Although small in number they are negatively impacting crop production.
pm_tribble_take_over_2_desc: The population of Tribbles on this planet is out of control!
pm_tycho_city_desc: One of several lunar landmarks large enough to be seen from Earth in the daytime.
pm_unimatrix_main_desc: The large central core of Borg operations. The Unicomplex exudes massive influence over the surrounding area of space.
pm_vaadwaur_awoken_desc: The Vaadwaur have awoke and reclaimed their ancient world, imposing their order and control over the planet.
pm_waste_build_up_desc: Failure to dispose of harmful toxic waste has damaged the environment and harmed living conditions.
pm_waste_removed_desc: All traces of pollutants have been removed from this planet so it is now an eco haven.
pm_wet_alpine_world_desc: A Minshara class world. The Alpine-type class M planet has a mountainous surface. Snow covers the mountaintops and frozen-over lakes dot the valleys. While the planet experiences minimal seasonal variations. The still-liquid water beneath the frozen surface of the lakes is enough to sustain some hardy vegetation.
pm_wet_gaia_world_desc: A perfect eco-system - who would not want to live here.
pm_wet_high_jungle_world_desc: Subtropical climates are often characterised by hot summers and mild winters with infrequent frost.
pm_wet_karst_world_desc: Karst is a topography formed from the dissolution of soluble rocks such as limestone, dolomite, and gypsum. It is characterised by underground drainage systems with sinkholes and caves.
pm_wet_mushroom_world_desc: Mycelial networks crisscross under the surface of this world, forming massive singular organisms that grow as fungus throughout the planet.
pm_wet_ocean_world_desc: Pelagic planets are ocean worlds n which the surface of the planet consists of at least 80% water. The atmosphere consists of nitrogen, oxygen and trace elements, such as inert gases. Pelagic planets can support a variety of marine life, and occasionally support humanoid life forms.
pm_wet_praire_world_desc: Filled with ecosystems that are considered part of the temperate grasslands, savannas, and shrublands biome, these prairie worlds have moderate rainfall, and a composition of grasses, herbs, and shrubs rather than trees as the dominant vegetation type.
pm_wet_retinal_world_desc: Rather than the regular chlorophyll-based vegetation found on many worlds, the vegetation here absorbs retinaldehyde, giving everything a purplish tinge rather than green.
pm_wet_rogue_world_desc: Every class-R planet began its life as a normal world, probably an M-class planet. However, at some point in its evolution, the planet was violently ejected from its orbit - most likely when a stellar mass crossed near its planetary system millennia ago. Most R-class planets now sail across the galaxy, while a few settle into uneasy orbits around other stars.
pm_wet_steppe_world_desc: Steppes, large areas of flat unforested grassland, cover vast portions of the continents on this planet.
pm_wet_super_habitable_world_desc: Exceedingly rare in nature, class Q-variable planets have an unstable ecosystem caused by a highly eccentric orbit, orbiting a trinary star system, or orbiting a star with a highly variable output. They are composed of countless biomes and micro-climates. Deserts and rainforests can co-exist within a few kilometres of each other. Almost every life form can find some part of this world suitable for habitation, but Q-class planets are nearly impossible to terraform due to their volatile nature.
pm_wet_swamp_world_desc: A Minshara class world. The Marshland-type class M planet has an abnormally high ratio of water vapor in its highly-charged atmosphere. Volatile storms and floods are frequent, and the ecosystem has learned to adapt and even to flourish.
pm_wet_temperate_world_desc: A Minshara class world. The Temperate-type class M planet is a true Goldilocks planet, with a stable climate and zones of both hot and cold allowing for diverse ecosystems to form.
pm_wet_tidal_world_desc: Class Z (Tidal Locked) planets started their life, long ago, as a standard M-class planet. However, due to low amount of fissionable, their core died down earlier than on average. Without an active core, the planet lost it magnetic field and slowly became tidally locked with its sun. This caused most of the atmosphere to quickly boil away. Life now can only survive in tiny pockets on the dark side of the planet, where there is still some heat, water and atmosphere.
pm_wet_tropical_world_desc: A Minshara class world. The Tropical-type class M planet is a humid, rocky world. Seasons with significant precipitation are interchanged with drier periods. Most landmasses are covered in dense vegetation.
pm_weytahn_siege_desc: The Andorian Empire has landed troops and have laid siege to this settlement.
pm_wild_mugato_desc: There are wild Mugato lose and in close proximity to civilian populations, causing fear and anger. Eventually the civilians will remove the threat on their own.
po_arxolite_corruption_desc: Arxolite Corruption has spread throughout this population, affecting productivity and increasing the risk of death.
po_centauran_flu_desc: Centauran Flu has spread throughout this population, affecting productivity and increasing the risk of death.
po_changeling_growth_desc: Deeper insight into the universe via contemplations via the Great Link have allowed us to grow.
po_food_deficit_desc: State wide lack of food is negatively impacting the organic population by decreasing their happiness and growth rates.
po_kentaran_pox_desc: Kentaran Pox has spread throughout this population, affecting productivity and increasing the risk of death.
po_laurentian_plague_desc: Laurentian Plague has spread throughout this population, affecting productivity and increasing the risk of death.
po_manxilite_corruption_desc: Manxilite Corruption has spread throughout this population, affecting productivity and increasing the risk of death.
po_monoclinic_paguphage_desc: Monoclinic Paguphage has spread throughout this population, affecting productivity and increasing the risk of death.
po_remans_citizens_desc: Our senate's decision to allow the Reman's equal rights has deeply wounded the Romulan pride.
po_remans_slave_desc: Our government's decision to reject the Reman's request to have equal rights, reminds us of our place as a the superior species.
po_rhombic_paguphage_desc: Rhombic Paguphage has spread throughout this population, affecting productivity and increasing the risk of death.
po_seripian_flu_desc: Seripian Flu has spread throughout this population, affecting productivity and increasing the risk of death.
po_tanerian_plague_desc: Tanerian Plague has spread throughout this population, affecting productivity and increasing the risk of death.

po_xindi_homeworld_relics_desc: Discoveries from the ruins of Xindus have provided new hope.

pop_discrimination_desc: Discrimination against [Root.GetSpeciesName]s on [From.GetName] is severely impacting the happiness and productivity of workers.

pop_enraged_from_homeworld_isolation: Pop militarised due to home system isolation
pop_gorn_infant_desc: This species' young are wild and feral, fighting for dominance and a chance to survive.
pop_nervous_desc: Increasing tensions on [From.GetName] have started to impact the happiness and productivity of [Root.GetSpeciesName] workers.
pop_saved_from_crime: Pop freed from a life of crime
pop_seething_from_homeworld_destruction: Pop nervous due to home system destruction
prewarp_age_desc: This civilisation is an advanced society but does not pursue the regular trappings of space travel.
prolonged_drought_desc: There are extremely scarce water reserves on this planet, which is the reason for the occasional season of prolonged drought, which can last for decades.
promoted_isolationist_desc: The Isolationist Ethic is being promoted by the government.
qonos_colony_desc: Qo'Nos, the Klingon homeworld, is an old planet, with a deep crust riddled with caves. Those caves are a result of lava flows from a series of now dormant supervolcanoes. Some of these caves are of truly substantial size - amongst are the cave of Kahless and the caves of No'Mat.
religious_colony_desc: This entire world is a spiritual retreat.
religious_colony_other_planets_desc: We have a Religious colony within our empire.
remus_colony_desc: Once Remus was properly trapped in orbit and the atmosphere overcooked due to its new tidal cycle, the planet's lean ecosystem retreated into caves deep in the dark side of the planet. When the Romulans came to the Romulus star system, they built massive biodomes that allowed the indigenous remnants to thrive - and mine the planet's rich dilithium deposits.
resort_colony_other_planets_desc: Landscaped to perfection and featuring a fully customisable global weather control system, every facet of this world's design is devoted to providing a wide range of vacation options for citizens in need of relaxation.
romulan_system_jamming_desc: This system is actively blocking any attempts to scan it.
rure_colony_desc: The surface temperature of Rura Penthe is extremely low, the landscape dominated by glaciers and gusting snow. Widely known as 'the alien's graveyard' due to the fact that the life expectancy for a prisoner there is, at most, one year.
science_station_bonus_desc: Our science centre provides additional research bonus due to its cutting edge facilities and brilliant minds.
sensor_system_jamming_desc: This system contains a phenomenon that blocks sensors from scanning it.
sh_32_century_desc: All the experience and tech of a 32nd Century ship.
sh_asteroid_desc: A big Asteroid prepared to make a deep impact and cause armageddon.
sh_borg_event_ship_difficulty_desc: Now witness the firepower of this fully armed and operational battle station.
sh_chroniton_frequency_desc: The Chroniton frequency of this vessel has been decrypted allowing our enemies to modify their shields against our weapons.
sh_crewed_by_androids_desc: This ship is under the control of a rogue AI heightening its response times and reaction rates.
sh_delta_q_ship_desc: Isolated in a far quadrant of space, this ship is more self sufficient than usual.
sh_dominion_invasion_desc: Fleet Sent from the Dominion to help capture the Alpha Quadrant.
sh_fleet_pseudorepair_desc: Fleet designated as due for repair.
sh_invaders_repelled_desc: We have successfully fought off the boarding team, boosting crew moral.
sh_jump_drive_expert_desc: This ship and crew are experts at traveling faster than traditional warp speeds allow.
sh_kelvin_enterprise_desc: A cross over from another time and universe, this ship is a powerful asset.
sh_locutus_killed: The Borg envoy has been killed
sh_locutus_sleep: The Borg Sleep command has been engaged

subject_great_house_members_1: A Great House of the Empire
subject_great_house_members_1_desc: A unified Empire is a threat to all that dare oppose it.
subject_ufp_members_1_desc: A growing Federation brings security and prosperity to all members.
suppressed_isolationist_desc: The Isolationist Ethic is being suppressed by the government.
suppressed_science_desc: With the radical origin theory and anything related to it strictly forbidding, our scientist have become wary of bringing fort new ideas, significantly slowing down our technological progress.
surface_impact_desc: In the distant past this world was impacted by a large asteroid, destroying all life on the surface and irradiating the surface contaminating the soil and water supply.
swamp_planet_desc: The vast majority of the surface of this planet is covered by endless bogs. The natural atmospheric processes caused by constant fogs and fumes disrupt the operation of communication facilities. The abundance of organic gases and their influence on the local flora and fauna makes this planet interesting for biological research.
tactic_v_borg_desc: Tactical Bonus provided by our subjects vs The Borg.
tactic_v_default_desc: Tactical Bonus provided by our subjects vs ordinary foes.
tactic_v_fe_desc: Tactical Bonus provided by our subjects vs Fallen Empires.
tactic_v_undine_desc: Tactical Bonus provided by our subjects vs The Undine.
talshiar_discontent_desc: The population have fought back against the intrusions of the Tal Shiar and are a few steps away from open revolt.
tars_lamora_desc: The site of the Tars Lamora Labor Camp ruled by the Diviner, where slaves were brought to mine the planetoid.
terrible_hurricanes_desc: The surface of this planet can quickly heat up, unlike the colder atmosphere, which is a favorable environment for the creation of eternal storm zones. The terrible storms and tornadoes are raging on these lands, bringing with them chaos and destruction.
terrorist_attack_desc: Terrorist attacks have reduced stability across the planet as citizens fear for their lives.
triggered_alpha_invaders_desc: This empire has travelled from across the galaxy and is threatening the order of things in the Gamma Quadrant.
triggered_anti_greed_desc: Our culture is wary of the criminal nature of elements of this society.
triggered_colAndor_attack: Violence used to retrieve colAndor Scrolls
triggered_disloyal_to_the_empire_desc: As a loyal house of the Empire, we are offended by those who disrespect the High Council.
triggered_distrust_of_shapeshifters_desc: A species that hides its true form cannot be trusted and should be treated with hostility.
triggered_distrust_of_solids_desc: The solids have proved over the course of our history that they cannot be trusted following the persecution of our species.
triggered_heliocide_home_system_wary: Destruction of a Species' Home System

Rotating power among the Xindi races ensures stability. 
Unity: +50

xindus_colony_desc: After the destruction of Xindus, the remaining Xindi species fled to this beautiful world, where each species adapted in their own way to cope with the planets unique environment. The Aquatics were immediately at home in the vast oceans, whilst the islands dotting the world became the starting point for the vast underwater colonies that the other Xindi species would call home.
young_world_desc: This planet is at an early stage of the biosphere, active volcanic activity is taking place on the planet, which creates more severe conditions for settlers, but the internal activity of the mantle significantly increases the planet's energy potential.

As the RCS is responsible for the majority of the fine movements and evasive action of a vessel, this change provides two benefits. The evasive movements of the ship thus become harder to predict. It also lowers the total heat profile of the ship, making it harder to track in general.

Repositioned warp coils create a more dense subspace bubble than normal, forcing the vessel through the weakened region of space, into transwarp space.

UTILITY_LARGE_BORG_LAB_1_DESC: Several layers of data nodes dedicated to sifting through information obtained by this ship of the collective.
UTILITY_REACTOR_1_LARGE_DESC: Basic nuclear power. Control rods moderate a Uranium pile to generate nuclear energy.
UTILITY_REACTOR_1_MEDIUM_DESC: Basic nuclear power. Control rods moderate a Uranium pile to generate nuclear energy.
UTILITY_REACTOR_1_SMALL_DESC: Basic nuclear power. Control rods moderate a Uranium pile to generate nuclear energy.
UTILITY_REACTOR_2_LARGE_DESC: Experimentation with magnetic coils and lasers has yielded the ability to reproduce the energy process found within stars.
UTILITY_REACTOR_2_MEDIUM_DESC: Experimentation with magnetic coils and lasers has yielded the ability to reproduce the energy process found within stars.
UTILITY_REACTOR_2_SMALL_DESC: Experimentation with magnetic coils and lasers has yielded the ability to reproduce the energy process found within stars.
UTILITY_REACTOR_3_LARGE_DESC: Helium-4 nuclear fusion reactor with a carbon-oxygen byproduct.
UTILITY_REACTOR_3_MEDIUM_DESC: Helium-4 nuclear fusion reactor with a carbon-oxygen byproduct.
UTILITY_REACTOR_3_SMALL_DESC: Helium-4 nuclear fusion reactor with a carbon-oxygen byproduct.
UTILITY_REACTOR_4_LARGE_DESC: Improvements in magnetic containment and laser ignition have resulted in better fusion reactions.
UTILITY_REACTOR_4_MEDIUM_DESC: Improvements in magnetic containment and laser ignition have resulted in better fusion reactions.
UTILITY_REACTOR_4_SMALL_DESC: Improvements in magnetic containment and laser ignition have resulted in better fusion reactions.
UTILITY_REACTOR_5_LARGE_DESC: Miniaturised fusion reactors are assembled together to provide maximum fuel economy, part redundancy and increased power output.
UTILITY_REACTOR_5_MEDIUM_DESC: Miniaturised fusion reactors are assembled together to provide maximum fuel economy, part redundancy and increased power output.
UTILITY_REACTOR_5_SMALL_DESC: Miniaturised fusion reactors are assembled together to provide maximum fuel economy, part redundancy and increased power output.
UTILITY_REACTOR_6_LARGE_DESC: Carefully shielded device that harnesses thermionic radiation.
UTILITY_REACTOR_6_MEDIUM_DESC: Carefully shielded device that harnesses thermionic radiation.
UTILITY_REACTOR_6_SMALL_DESC: Carefully shielded device that harnesses thermionic radiation.
UTILITY_REACTOR_7_LARGE_DESC: A miniature space-time rift is used to create a radiation source. Hardware adapted from thermionic and fission control systems is used to absorb this radiation for generating power.
UTILITY_REACTOR_7_MEDIUM_DESC: A miniature space-time rift is used to create a radiation source. Hardware adapted from thermionic and fission control systems is used to absorb this radiation for generating power.
UTILITY_REACTOR_7_SMALL_DESC: A miniature space-time rift is used to create a radiation source. Hardware adapted from thermionic and fission control systems is used to absorb this radiation for generating power.
UTILITY_REACTOR_PERGIUM_LARGE_DESC: Pergium is blended with other radioactive compounds to create an enhanced fission reactor. It's not as clean as fusion, but it increases the availability of radioactive fuel sources in general.
UTILITY_REACTOR_PERGIUM_MEDIUM_DESC: Pergium is blended with other radioactive compounds to create an enhanced fission reactor. It's not as clean as fusion, but it increases the availability of radioactive fuel sources in general.
UTILITY_REACTOR_PERGIUM_SMALL_DESC: Pergium is blended with other radioactive compounds to create an enhanced fission reactor. It's not as clean as fusion, but it increases the availability of radioactive fuel sources in general.
UTILITY_REACTOR_SOLAR_LARGE_DESC: A unique design created by the Kessok, absorbing the energy from nearby stars and converting it into a huge amount of energy.
UTILITY_REACTOR_SOLAR_MEDIUM_DESC: A unique design created by the Kessok, absorbing the energy from nearby stars and converting it into a huge amount of energy.
UTILITY_REACTOR_SOLAR_SMALL_DESC: A unique design created by the Kessok, absorbing the energy from nearby stars and converting it into a huge amount of energy.
UTILITY_REACTOR_THALARON_LARGE_DESC: A thalaron reactor is a device designed to harness thalaron radiation safely in order to produce large amounts of power. If not kept stable, it can emit a cascading biogenic pulse with which to destroy all organic matter.
UTILITY_REACTOR_THALARON_MEDIUM_DESC: A thalaron reactor is a device designed to harness thalaron radiation safely in order to produce large amounts of power. If not kept stable, it can emit a cascading biogenic pulse with which to destroy all organic matter.

required_aura_battleship_borg_adaptive_1: Este plexo foi adaptado para facilitar a interligação de cérebros de drones em regeneração num núcleo de computador orgânico. Isso é obtido usando um nó de comunicação de banda larga super alta e grande quantidade de energia disponível para o drone a partir da rede elétrica da nave.
required_aura_battleship_borg_adaptive_2: O plexo central liga cada nave Borg a todas as outras naves Borg. Isto facilita a transferência rápida e eficiente do conhecimento do Coletivo e dados táticos em tempo real. Também permite que o computador de cada nave descarregue as tarefas de processamento para outras naves durante períodos de alta demanda.
required_aura_battleship_borg_adaptive_3: As comunicações subespaciais em tempo real permitem a rápida comunicação e processamento de dados durante os períodos de demanda, resultando em rápida adaptação.
required_aura_battleship_borg_adaptive_4: As comunicações via transwarp são agora possíveis num ambiente tático que permite o processamento de energia de fontes tão distantes quanto os sistemas próximos a serem utilizados na adaptação de novas defesas.
required_aura_battleship_borg_repair_1_D: Usando feixes de energia faseados, as nanoprobes são entregues ao segmento de casco danificado da nave para iniciar a reparação sem perder a eficiência tática
required_aura_battleship_borg_repair_2_D: Com a adição de um nó de segmentação avançado, os feixes de energia faseada são capazes de fornecer nanossondas para a localização precisa de um segmento de casco danificado. Isso nos permite reparar naves de forma rápida e eficiente.
required_aura_battleship_borg_repair_3_D: Vigas triaxilantes concentram-se em segmentos danificados do casco, a fim de repará-los de forma rápida e eficiente. As naves próximas consertam-se rápida e eficientemente.
required_aura_battleship_borg_repair_4_D: Os campos de nanite podem ser projetados em grandes áreas de um casco danificado, a fim de preparar segmentos danificados. As naves próximas consertam rápida e eficientemente.
required_aura_battleship_borg_tractor_1_:
Um poderoso raio trator utilizado pelos Borg. Pode manter até naves grandes à distância e também ser usado em warp. 

 ^ Além do efeito do feixe do trator, todos os dias, o feixe de corte Borg causa uma média entre 10 e 20 pontos de £ stats_damage Damage para todas as naves inimigas em alcance de curto alcance.
required_aura_battleship_borg_tractor_2_:
A adição de um feixe de corte ao já mortal raio trator Borg permite que os Borg desfa;am naves inimigas em pedaços. 

 Além do efeito do feixe do trator, todos os dias, o raio Borg causa uma média entre 15 e 30 pontos de £ stats_damage Damage para todas as naves inimigos em curto alcance.
required_aura_battleship_borg_tractor_3_:
Com mais poder direcionado ao feixe de corte, os Borg podem literalmente desfazer frotas inimigas em pedaços. 

 Além do efeito do feixe do trator, todos os dias, o raio Borg causa uma média entre 20 e 40Ag pontos de £ Damage para todas as naves inimigas em curto alcance.
required_aura_battleship_borg_tractor_4_:
Com múltiplos emissores permitindo que o feixe de corte seja focado em seções particularmente endurecidas, os Borg podem literalmente destruir frotas inimigas em pedaços. 

 Além do efeito de feixe trator, todos os dias, o raio Borg causa uma média entre 25 e 50 pontos de £ stats_damage Damage para todas as naves inimigas em curto alcance.
required_aura_battleship_breen_1_DESC: Um novo componente que está disponível apenas para a raça Breen. Eles descobriram que, calculando um novo conjunto de frequências de feixe moduladas quando as suas naves de guerra disparam as armas, elas podem diminuir a taxa de fogo das naves inimigas.
required_aura_battleship_breen_2_DESC: Melhorias no dissipador de energia permitem que mais energia das armas seja drenada do inimigo, reduzindo ainda mais sua taxa de fogo.
required_aura_battleship_breen_3_DESC: Melhorias no dissipador de energia permitem que mais energia das armas seja drenada do inimigo, reduzindo ainda mais sua taxa de fogo.
required_aura_battleship_breen_4_DESC: O nosso dissipador hiperespacial forma anomalias subespaciais que drenam e amortecem a formação de energia dentro de câmaras de intermisturas extraterrestres, reduzindo assim o poder das armas inimigas.
required_aura_battleship_bridge_1_DESC: Centro de Comando Redundante para atividades navais. Também pode ser usado para comandar a parte separada de uma nave combinada.
required_aura_battleship_bridge_2_DESC: Um centro de comando melhorado com sistemas de comunicação e controlo para permitir que ofereça um comando superior de uma frota.
required_aura_battleship_bridge_3_DESC: Uma ponte de comando superior com écrãs e comunicações holográficas para comando e controle total sobre uma grande frota.
required_aura_battleship_disrupt_DESC: Este módulo exsuda matéria exótica na área em torno do couraçado e atrapalha o campo de batalha, o que anula quaisquer efeitos positivos que naves inimigas possam estar obtendo.
required_aura_battleship_gorn_jammer_1_D: A simple jamming technique, further enhanced by the Gorn, reflects optical sensors thus rendering vessels hard to detect or target.
required_aura_battleship_gorn_jammer_2_D: Gravimetric particles are used to surround a vessel, making it extremely difficult to target accurately.
required_aura_battleship_gorn_jammer_3_D: Unique to the Gorn, the subspace jammer masks a vessel's energy signature within a subspace field, making it extremely difficult to detect.
required_aura_battleship_gorn_jammer_4: Gorn Mk. V Holographic Spoofing Jammer
required_aura_battleship_gorn_jammer_4_D: Unique to the Gorn, the Holographical Spoofing Jammer creates hard light imagery to fool even the most detailed sensors.
required_aura_battleship_holographic_DES: Grandes emissores holográficos montados no casco permitem projeções holográficas em tamanho real das naves, fazendo com que uma nave pareça uma armada.
required_aura_battleship_repair_1_DESC: Um componente que, quando instalado na ponte de uma nave de guerra, funcionará como um depósito de reparos para navios próximos.
required_aura_battleship_repair_2_DESC: Um componente que, quando instalado na ponte de uma nave de guerra, funcionará como um depósito de reparos para navios próximos.
required_aura_battleship_repair_3_DESC: Nano-injectores roboticos podem ser injetados diretamente sobre o casco de naves próximas, aumentando assim a taxa de reparo.
required_aura_battleship_shield_1_DESC: Outro componente exclusivo de couraçados. Isto permite que os emissores de escudo dos couraçados projetem um escudo a uma distância maior da nave. Enquanto na vizinhança, ele pode ser usado para ajudar a re-energizar os gravitons de outros escudos amigáveis, aumentando assim a taxa de regeneração de seus escudos.
required_aura_battleship_shield_2_DESC: Melhorias nos emissores de escudos de couraçados permitem uma melhor reenergização dos escudos de naves aliadas.
required_aura_battleship_shield_3_DESC: O ajuste rápido da frequência de escudos aliados torna-os mais resistentes ao fogo inimigo.
required_aura_battleship_sweeper_DESC: Este módulo permite o direcionamento remoto e o acionamento de campos de minas inimigos, negando assim seus danos.
required_aura_battleship_web_1_DESC: A Teia Tholian, ou rede de trator, é composta de uma série de filamentos de energia que são gerados num padrão de teia ao redor de uma nave alvo. Uma vez que esses filamentos são selados, a teia se torna autogeradora e as naves de fiar não são mais necessárias para manter a teia.
required_aura_battleship_web_2_DESC: A teia Tholian, ou rede trator, é composta por uma série de filamentos de energia que são gerados num padrão de teia ao redor de uma nave alvo. Este módulo permite a criação dos filamentos de energia.
required_aura_battleship_web_3_DESC: A teia Tholian, ou rede trator, é composta por uma série de filamentos de energia que são gerados num padrão de teia ao redor de uma nave alvo. Este módulo permite a criação dos filamentos de energia.
required_aura_battleship_web_4_DESC: Embainhando os tecedores de filamentos numa teia de antimatéria, uma teia superluminal pode ser construída, que prende melhor as naves inimigas.
required_aura_cruiser_DESC: This cruiser module manages, transmits and coordinates numerous shielding frequencies of nearby vessels, thus strengthening their protection.
required_aura_cruiser_aceton_1_DESC: These devices can leech energy from nearby vessels, leaving them moribund and derelict.
required_aura_cruiser_aceton_2_DESC: Esses dispositivos aprimorados podem sugar a energia de naves próximas, deixando-as moribundas e abandonadas.
required_aura_cruiser_aceton_3_DESC: These enhanced devices can leech energy from nearby vessels, leaving them moribund and derelict.
required_aura_cruiser_aceton_ancient_1_D: An ancient powerful device that can leech energy from nearby vessels, leaving them derelict.
required_aura_cruiser_bio_damage_DESC: With joined minds the weak will perish.

required_aura_cruiser_defense_DESC:
Este módulo de computador dedicado e independente monitora o hardware e software de naves em tempo real contra quaisquer intrusões e interferências de uma ampla variedade de possíveis dispositivos inimigos. 

 \G Este dispositivo torna a nave imune a todas as formas de auras hostis.
required_aura_cruiser_dominion_marines_1: This module allows for the inclusion of a special regiment of marines aboard the vessel who offer a chance whilst in combat to board an enemy ship causing damage.

required_aura_cruiser_hirogen_marines_3_: This module allows for the inclusion of a special regiment of marines aboard the vessel who offer a chance whilst in combat to board an enemy ship causing damage.
required_aura_cruiser_jammer_1_DESC: Uma forma básica de contramedida eletrônica, usada para combater a detecção de raios laser e a detecção de infravermelhos. Conseguido gerando uma onda de radiação moduladora que dispersa ou sobrecarrega os sistemas básicos de rastreio.
required_aura_cruiser_jammer_2_DESC: Combinando contramedidas eletrônicas com um bloqueador de sinal gravimétrico, este dispositivo produz ondas graviton, o que torna extremamente difícil para o inimigo obter uma leitura exata da nossa localização. Quando implantados em uma nave, os sensores gravimétricos inimigos ficam sobrecarregados, dificultando bastante o direcionamento dos sensores para o alvo.
required_aura_cruiser_jammer_3_DESC: Este é verdadeiramente o auge da tecnologia de contramedidas, obtido com a adição de um Verteron Overload Jammer no topo de um pacote de contramedidas já impressionante. Este dispositivo usa pulsos Verteron multi-direcionais para sobrecarregar qualquer sensor inimigo que tente obter um alvo usando a assinatura do núcleo warp de uma nave. Quando combinado com todos os avanços tecnológicos anteriores, uma nave equipada com este dispositivo torna-se extremamente difícil de trancar como alvo.
required_aura_cruiser_marines_1_DESC: This module allows for the inclusion of a special regiment of marines aboard the vessel who offer a chance whilst in combat to board an enemy ship causing damage.
required_aura_cruiser_marines_2_DESC: An upgraded version of the boarding party module that allows for the inclusion of a special regiment of marines aboard the vessel who offer a chance whilst in combat to board an enemy ship causing damage.

required_aura_destroyer_defense_DESC:
Este dispositivo único é mais que um típico amortecedor inercial. Em vez disso, é um conjunto complexo de dispositivos de controle inercial de backup espalhados pela nave e ligados a giroscópios altamente calibrados. Este sistema permite que a nave resista a quase todos os tipos de ataques cinéticos e espaciais .

 Este dispositivo torna a nave imune a todas as formas de auras de armadilhas hostis.
required_aura_destroyer_gorn_jammer_1_DE: A simply jamming technique, further enhanced by the Gorn, this reflects optical sensors thus rendering vessels hard to detect or target.

required_aura_destroyer_gorn_jammer_4_DE: Unique to the Gorn, the Holographical Spoofing Jammer creates hard light imagery to fool even the most detailed sensors.
required_aura_destroyer_inhibitor_1_DESC: O Império Tkon em tempos usou planetas inteiros para atuar como inibidores de warp. Embora isto não seja um planeta usa as mesmas idéias. Um poço de gravidade artificial é criado, retardando a criação de quaisquer bolhas de warp e arrastando as naves para fora de warp se eles passarem perto
required_aura_destroyer_inhibitor_2_DESC: Armas isoliticas causam uma ruptura no subespaço perto do alvo. A anomalia move-se em direção ao alvo à velocidade da luz causando estragos em motores de warp
required_aura_destroyer_inhibitor_3_DESC: Uma onda de choque temporal é um poderoso acúmulo de energia temporal que viaja através do espaço, causando interrupção na linha do tempo à medida que se propaga e causa estragos nos sistemas das naves.
required_aura_destroyer_sweeper_DESC: Este módulo permite o direcionamento remoto e o acionamento de campos de minas inimigos, negando assim seus danos.
required_aura_destroyer_tractor_1_DESC: O grappler dispara uma garra magnética presa a um cabo de reboque de nanopolímero pesado que pode agarrar objetos no espaço. Os grapplers utilizam um dispositivo de tranca magnética para anexar objetos.
required_aura_destroyer_tractor_2_DESC: Um feixe colimado de gravitons é usado para agarrar diversos objetos, desde detritos espaciais até uma nave espacial.
required_aura_destroyer_tractor_3_DESC: A fim de manter objetos maiores ou objetos não sólidos, o raio do trator é reforçado com pulsos de alta energia, permitindo que ele mova objetos massivos, como fragmentos do núcleo estelar.
required_aura_destroyer_tractor_4_DESC: Remodular os feixes do trator para compensar a interferência do subespaço permite que esses feixes tractores segurem objetos através de escudos e outros obstáculos.
required_aura_destroyer_web_1_DESC: A teia de Tholian, ou rede de tractor, é composta de uma série de filamentos de energia que são gerados num padrão de teia ao redor de uma nave alvo. Uma vez que esses filamentos sejam selados, a teia se torna autogeradora e as naves de fiar não são mais necessárias para manter a teia.
required_aura_destroyer_web_2_DESC: A teia de Tholian, ou rede de trator, é composta de uma série de filamentos de energia que são gerados em um padrão de teia ao redor de um vaso alvo. Este módulo permite a criação dos filamentos de energia.
required_aura_destroyer_web_3_DESC: A teia de Tholian, ou rede de trator, é composta de uma série de filamentos de energia que são gerados em um padrão de teia ao redor de um vaso alvo. Este módulo permite a criação dos filamentos de energia.
required_aura_destroyer_web_4_DESC: Embainhando os filamentos numa teia de antimatéria, uma teia superluminal pode ser construída, o que prende as naves inimigas.
required_aura_loaned_cloak_DESC: Device provided by the Romulan Star Empire to investigate unusual activity in the Gamma Quadrant.

required_hero_computer_1_DESC: By utilising the intrinsic spin of the electron, this solid state computer can be dedicated to weapon systems.
required_hero_computer_2_DESC: Optical computers represent a significant advancement in tactical simulation. By installing these upgrades all around our starship we will see an increased performance to our starships weapon systems.
required_hero_computer_3_DESC: We have designed new computer components based on the breakthroughs in duotronic technology developed by Dr. Richard Daystrom. These revolutionary new computational systems are capable of the advanced calculations needed to noticeably improve target locks and weapon tuning optimisations.
required_hero_computer_4_DESC: Multitronic computers utilise very sophisticated technology based on next-level deep neural webs. This allows for a computer that can think and reason, and eventually, even assist in strategy development, ship management and research.
required_hero_computer_5_DESC: Our understanding of isolinear chip technology has given us the ability to design a new type of computer component that will feature these advanced nanoprocessors to aid in the tactical simulations of our starships weapons, however, due to the easily corruptible nature of these chips, our weapon damage will be very similar to that of our Duotronic based computers.
required_hero_computer_6_DESC: A new type of computer component designed from bio-neural gel packs help store more information and operate at faster speeds than our previous isolinear computers designs, thereby increasing our tactical simulations to our starship weapon systems by a sizable amount.
required_hero_computer_7_DESC: Using advanced cortical implants, every member of the crew can access quickly and inutility every facet of the ship controls at any time and from any location. Merging this tactic with next-stage neural gel computer network, the ship becomes almost a living thing, capable of performing a great deal of calculations instantaneously and predict enemy movement in an almost instinctive way.
required_science_anti_cloak_1_DESC: A Gravitational Field Emitter can be used to detect micro-shifts in the gravitational field around a cloaked vessel allowing limited detection of cloaked vessels using weak cloaking devices.
required_science_anti_cloak_2_DESC: A targetted sweep can pickup energy 'distortions', manifesting themselves most often as refracting visible light energy from surrounding stellar objects very near the cloaked ship's outline, appearing as a 'shimmering' effect, while cloaked and prior to decloaking, could give away a cloaked ship when observed.
required_science_anti_cloak_3_DESC: A tachyon detection grid was a technique developed as a means of detecting cloaked warships. The grid used active tachyon beams transmitted between different starships or sentry posts to create a tachyon field; any cloaked ship entering this field would be exposed.
required_science_anti_cloak_4_DESC: These beacons were positron-based, and had an output of two hundred gigawatts. The subassembly tolerances were isolated from the emitter algorithms, which was made possible by generating a stable flux between the positronic conductors and renormalizing the tertiary wave functions.
required_science_backup_DESC: Supplementary air, water and power. Without these, death in space is easily achieved.
required_science_escape_1_DESC: Enhanced escape pods provide increased survivability for the crew and leaders in case of disaster.
required_science_fed_cloak_1_DESC: Sensor blocking is enhanced by holographic emitters projecting a camouflage, disguising the vessel as another object, such as an asteroid or comet.
required_science_fed_cloak_2_DESC: Light diffusion and sensor blocking are further augmented by chroniton particle generation. This combination allows a ship to move seamlessly through solid matter.
required_science_generic_cloak_1_DESC: Basic light and radar diffusion system. Equipped vessels are harder to detect at medium- to long-range.
required_science_generic_cloak_2_DESC: Spatial Displacement shifts objects slightly out of phase with our space-time continuum, acting as a highly advanced cloaking device.
required_science_generic_cloak_3_DESC: Through the generation of a chroniton field, a high state of temporal polarisation is created, putting the ship in a state of temporal flux. This moves it slightly out of phase with space-time, making it extremely difficult to detect.
required_science_kdf_cloak_1_DESC: Basic light and radar diffusion system. Equipped vessels are harder to detect at medium- to long-range.
required_science_kdf_cloak_2_DESC: Equipped vessels are nearly impossible to detect with the naked eye or with most sensor systems
required_science_lab_engineering_1_DESC: An additional onboard engineering laboratory, outfitted with everything needed to engineer science.
required_science_lab_physics_1_DESC: An additional onboard chemistry laboratory, outfitted with deep mineral scanners and hazardous material storage.
required_science_lab_society_1_DESC: An additional onboard biology laboratory, outfitted with detectors for DNA, lifeforms, pulse height analysers, and biogenic analysis.
required_science_rom_cloak_1_DESC: Basic holographic and radar diffusion system. Equipped vessels are harder to detect at medium- to long-range
required_science_rom_cloak_2_DESC: Light diffusion and sensor blocking is further augmented by chroniton particle generation.
required_science_rom_cloak_3_DESC: Through the generation of dual cloaking fields, a high state of polarisation is created, putting the ship in a state of flux. This moves it slightly out of phase with space-time, making it extremely difficult to detect.
required_science_specialisation_diplomac: Science Ships are equipped with additional embassy modules, allowing science vessels to aid planetary government.
required_science_specialisation_engineer: Science Ships are equipped with additional engineering modules, allowing science vessels to assist planetary infrastructure as long as an engineering leader leads the fleet.
required_science_specialisation_flagship: Flagships are equipped with Flagship facilities and modules allowing this ship to perform flagship planetary missions.
required_science_specialisation_medical_: Science Ships are equipped with additional medical modules, allowing science vessels to Set up orbital hospitals as long as a medical leader leads the fleet.
required_science_specialisation_science_: Science Ships are equipped with the default module, allowing science vessels to Assist Planetary Research.
required_science_specialisation_security: This ship is equipped with security facilities and modules allowing this ship to assist planet security.
required_sensor_civilian_1_DESC: A basic radar system that increases sensor range on our civilian vessels.
required_sensor_mobile_station_1_DESC: A basic radar system that increases sensor range on our starbases.
required_sensor_mobile_station_2_DESC: These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
required_sensor_mobile_station_3_DESC: These sensors have been tuned to more precisely detect the decay of tachyons emitted by all warp capable starships, resulting in increased detection range and tracking capabilities.
required_sensor_mobile_station_4_DESC: These sensors have been tuned to scan all multiphasic bands allowing it to pick up signals emitted by all warp-capable starships, resulting in increased detection range and tracking capabilities.
required_sensor_science_1_DESC: Our most basic array component that increases the range of our sensors on our starships.
required_sensor_science_2_DESC: These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
required_sensor_science_3_DESC: These sensors have been tuned to more precisely detect the decay of tachyons emitted by all warp capable starships, resulting in increased detection range and tracking capabilities.
required_sensor_science_4_DESC: Sensors that penetrate even the most advanced interference caused by natural and unnatural means leading to vastly increased sensor range and detection capabilities of the movement of enemy starships.
